# Project Manager
London, UKHybrid (2 days in office)Posted 31 October 2024
Apply for this roleSee all roles
## About the role
As a Project Manager at 247 Commerce, you will be the heartbeat of our delivery team. You will be responsible for orchestrating complex eCommerce projects for some of the UK's most exciting brands. You will act as the bridge between our clients and our technical teams, ensuring clear communication, meticulous planning, and successful execution. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is passionate about eCommerce, and has a knack for problem-solving.
## What you will do
* Lead the end-to-end delivery of eCommerce projects (Adobe Commerce, Shopify, BigCommerce) from discovery to launch.
* Create and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets.
* Manage client expectations and communications, acting as the primary point of contact.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams including developers, designers, and QA engineers across multiple time zones (UK, Romania, India).
* Identify and mitigate project risks and issues proactively.
* Ensure projects are delivered to the highest quality standards and within scope.
* Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
## What you bring
* 3+ years of experience in Project Management within a digital agency or eCommerce environment.
* Proven track record of delivering complex web development projects.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Trello).
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Familiarity with eCommerce platforms like Adobe Commerce (Magento), Shopify, or BigCommerce is highly desirable.
## Nice to have
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Scrum Master certification.
* Technical background or understanding of web technologies.
## What we offer
* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* 25 days paid holiday + bank holidays.
* Hybrid working model (London office).
* Salary-sacrifice pension scheme.
* Octopus EV Car Lease scheme.
* Regular team socials and events.
* Professional development budget.

Who We Are At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.
Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.
Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.
If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 7+ years. You can be the go-to leader for any software development engagement. You have a broad and deep range of expertise that allows you to make an immediate impact on projects. In your previous experience, you have:
Successfully led high-stakes consulting engagements from discovery to production Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served Written production-quality code using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL
Leveraged AI-assistive development tools for tasks like scaffolding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation
Experience building or integrating AI/ML-powered features into products or systems (e.g., recommendation engines, NLP models, computer vision, predictive analytics) Used context-appropriate automated testing to inform software design choices and catch bugs
Debugged and refactored pre-existing code to incrementally improve it
Collaborated with teams using Git, MacOS/Linux, and CI/CD
Remedied architecture-level concerns such as scalability, security, reliability, and performance
Brought together people from different functions and perspectives in forums that encourage idea sharing, collaboration, and problem solving
Made thoughtful recommendations and set direction in the face of ambiguity
Mentored and shared knowledge with colleagues
Actively sought out and effectively given feedback
Communicated empathically with stakeholders and colleagues
Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs

As a lead technologist on projects, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, through a variety of technologies and frameworks over the course of your career with us. Making immediate contributions to projects, rapidly building trust with clients
Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
Leading architecture and software design discussions
Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
Generating new potential solutions to challenges (technical and non-technical) in partnership with team members and clients

Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values

Managing high-level project roadmaps as the team lead for large engagements
Maintaining relationships with client technical leaders

Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress

Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
DevSecOps & DevOps
MLOps

# Senior Stress Engineer
## Join AALTO in Farnborough as a Senior Stress Engineer, leading structural analysis for Zephyr and helping unlock the future of Stratospace.
AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.
Zephyr’s persistence enables continuous flight for months at a time. Its current flight-time record of over 67 days in the stratosphere. From above 60,000+ft, or 20km above ground, AALTO can deliver several applications including direct-to-device connectivity and high-resolution Earth observation.
AALTO operates in a new operational layer between most of air traffic and low-Earth orbit, Stratospace. This is where high-altitude platforms led by Zephyr deliver services to commercial and government partners. We can help monitor environments, observe borders, track natural disasters and connect unconnected communities.
Join us as we create a new domain of aerospace: Stratospace. You’ll be part of a highly-skilled, innovative and passionate group of people – Team AALTO. Together, we can Unlock Stratospace.
**About The Role**
This is an exciting opportunity for a **Senior Stress Engineer** take ownership of structural analysis activities across the product lifecycle, from early concept studies through to production support and in-service design improvements.
You will play a key role in developing structural design solutions for current and future aircraft, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to overcome complex design and programme challenges. The role combines analytical expertise, practical problem-solving, and hands-on support to manufacturing and maintenance teams, helping to ensure the continued safety, performance, and reliability of our aircraft.
**Responsibilities to include:**
· Lead structural analysis activities throughout the aircraft design and development process.
· Conduct material selection and structural concept trade studies during preliminary design phases.
· Develop and maintain structural design records using applicable historical data and analysis.
· Provide structural engineering support and decision-making for production and line maintenance activities.
· Collaborate with mechanical design engineers to develop detailed design solutions for new and existing aircraft platforms.
· Provide technical guidance and specialist advice to cross-functional product development teams.
· Support concept studies, design reviews, and the resolution of build-related engineering challenges.
· Plan and support structural and materials testing activities required for design validation and certification.
· Lead or contribute to engineering reviews for assigned work packages.
· Support production teams by investigating and resolving structural repairs, concessions, and deviation requests.
· Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance product quality, performance, and manufacturing efficiency.
· Maintain and develop technical knowledge, skills, and professional competence within the discipline.
**Skills and Knowledge Required**
· Proven experience in structural stress analysis within the aviation or aerospace industry.
· Strong understanding of aircraft structural design principles and requirements verification.
· Experience performing both Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and classical hand calculations.
· Working knowledge of composite materials and composite structural analysis methodologies.
· Proficiency with industry-standard analysis tools such as ANSYS, Nastran, or equivalent software.
· Ability to interpret engineering requirements and translate them into robust analytical solutions.
· Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to support both design and production environments.
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in multidisciplinary engineering teams.
· Ability to review, challenge, and justify engineering decisions using sound technical reasoning.
· Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and engineering excellence.
**In addition to a competitive, market-aligned salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and work-life balance:**
**Performance Bonus** Benefit from our short-term incentive plan, recognising and rewarding individual and company success.
**Generous Annual Leave** Enjoy 25 days of annual leave, giving you the time to rest, recharge, and spend time on what matters most.
**Private Healthcare** Access private medical insurance, alongside dental and optical cashback schemes, helping you and your family stay healthy.
**Pension Contributions** Plan confidently for the future with our competitive personal pension scheme.
**Income Protection & Life Assurance** Gain added peace of mind through income protection and life assurance cover, providing support when you need it most.
**Electric Vehicle & Car Scheme** Access our salary sacrifice vehicle scheme, offering a cost-effective way to drive the latest cars.
**Employee Assistance Programme** Receive confidential professional support whenever you need it through our dedicated employee assistance programme.
**Employee Discounts** Enjoy a wide range of discounts and offers through Perkbox, covering everything from shopping and travel to leisure activities and everyday essentials.
This is all part of our commitment to creating an environment where our people can thrive both professionally and personally.

# Mechnical Design Engineer

AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.
Zephyr’s persistence enables continuous flight for months at a time. Its current flight-time record of over 67 days in the stratosphere. From above 60,000+ft, or 20km above ground, AALTO can deliver several applications including direct-to-device connectivity and high-resolution Earth observation.

We can help monitor environments, observe borders, track natural disasters and connect unconnected communities.
Join us as we create a new domain of aerospace: Stratospace. You’ll be part of a highly-skilled, innovative and passionate group of people – Team AALTO. Together, we can Unlock Stratospace.
**About The Role**
Join AALTO's innovative engineering team as a **Mechanical Design Engineer**, contributing to the design, development, and delivery of mechanical systems for Zephyr and future high-altitude aircraft platforms.
Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will develop mechanical design solutions that support the full product lifecycle, from concept development and detailed design through to manufacture, integration, testing, and operational support. The role offers significant opportunities for professional growth, allowing you to progressively take ownership of more complex engineering challenges as your technical expertise develops.

· Support the development of concept and detailed mechanical design solutions that meet product and system requirements.
· Create 3D CAD models, assemblies, and engineering drawings using SolidWorks or equivalent CAD software.
· Generate and maintain product definition data within PDM and PLM systems.

· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality, efficiency, manufacturability, and cost performance.
· Support root cause investigations and failure analysis activities associated with design, manufacturing, or operational issues.
· Develop knowledge and expertise in composite structures, aerospace engineering practices, and Design Organisation processes.
· Effectively manage assigned work packages, communicating progress, risks, and issues to technical leads and managers.

· Degree, HND, or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
· Typically 2-5 years' experience within aerospace, defence, or another highly regulated engineering industry.
· Experience using professional 3D CAD software, with SolidWorks experience highly advantageous.
· Strong capability in producing engineering drawings, models, and technical documentation.
· Understanding of engineering design methodologies and product lifecycle management processes.
· Experience working with PDM and PLM systems.
· Ability to interpret technical requirements and develop practical engineering solutions.
· Understanding of manufacturing processes and design for manufacture principles.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
· Excellent communication and collaboration abilities within multidisciplinary teams.

## **About the Role**
Abnormal is growing fast, and the way we show up in the world has to keep pace. Our Strategic Events are where our story stops being a pitch and starts being an experience, where CISOs and practitioners walk in curious and walk out convinced. This role will support the strategic events programs across EMEA, including major third-party events, flagship first-party events, and high-profile executive events.
As Strategic Events Specialist, EMEA, you'll bring new ideas and experiences to how we create impact across our events program. You're someone who thrives on a great project plan, keeping deadlines tracked and on target, and managing multiple stakeholders at once across different time zones. Your communication is second to none, and you're always thinking one step ahead when it comes to delivering an event, pre-event and on-site. You understand the importance of an event running smoothly, and love learning as you go to optimise for the future.
This role is perfect for somebody looking for their next step up: a hands-on IC role where you’ll play a lead role in some of our largest flagship events across EMEA, and pitch in on general team tasks day to day. You'll run established event formats independently and apply good judgement within known processes, while leaning on your manager for guidance on new or first-of-their-kind activations. If that sounds like your kind of thing, we want to hear from you!
## **How You'll Deliver Impact**
**Project Management, Event Logistics & Vendor Management**
* Support all event logistics end to end and take full ownership of numerous projects, such as creative tasks, room blocks, catering orders, swag orders, staff schedules, promotional assets, and much more.
* Help coordinate with external stakeholders, such as venues, agencies, event organisers, hotels, couriers, and many more.
* Help source agencies, venues, production partners and suppliers.
* Assist with run-of-shows, timelines and contingency plans across multiple concurrent events and markets.
* Coordinate invitation strategy, registration, attendee communications and internal promotion so the right people show up, market by market.
**Regional Strategy & Portfolio Support**
* Support the EMEA strategic event mapping and calendar planning, prioritising investment against pipeline and account-engagement goals.
* Share experiences and feedback on which events make most sense for our strategic events program across EMEA.
**Internal Cross-Functional & Partner/Alliance Collaboration**
* Build relationships with Regional Revenue Marketing, Sales, SDR/BDR, Customer Marketing, Product, Sales Engineering, Partner/Alliance Marketing and Brand/Creative across regions and time zones.
* Work closely with the Revenue Marketing Manager team to ensure Sales are fully enabled on all event details and what is expected of them.
**Budget Ownership & ROI Tracking**
* Support budget tracking for your owned events and the events you support.
* Suggest alternative, more cost-effective ways of doing things at events, including researching vendors and agencies for cost comparisons.
* Budget admin, including raising purchase orders, submitting invoices, and updating budget management tools.
**On-Site Execution**
* Lead on-site at your own events, including training other on-site team members and coordinating and leading staff orientations.
* Support on-site execution for flagship regional events, directing any temporary or contract event staff and troubleshooting in real time.
* Set clear expectations on-site for all teams by hosting staff orientations virtually and in person
**Post-Event Follow-Up & Program Result Accountability**
* Post-event admin, including list uploads and sending post-event reports.
* Help build repeatable regional playbooks and share best practice with peers across the broader Strategic Events team, including other regions
* Run post-event retrospectives and apply lessons learned to improve the next event, raising the bar for the regional program as it scales
* Ensure tight alignment with regional teams to ensure full ROI of event is realised, by sharing regular lead status update reports
## **What You Bring**
* 2–4 years' experience in B2B events or experiential marketing, ideally within technology, SaaS, cybersecurity or enterprise software.
* Experience of owning established, repeatable event formats end-to-end — not just coordinating logistics for someone else's plan — with sound judgement on known procedures and a willingness to ask for guidance on new or first-of-their-kind activations.
* Experience running executive-level programmes (dinners, roundtables, advisory boards) as well as larger conference/trade show activations.
* Multi-market EMEA experience and the ability to work across different time zones and regions.
* Strong program management habits: organised, deadline-driven, and increasingly independent on routine work.
* Budget, vendor and contract management experience across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Confidence working cross-functionally with Sales, SDR/BDR and Marketing stakeholders, and translating event activity into commercial outcomes.
* Comfortable presenting event results and ROI to stakeholders using registration, pipeline and engagement data.
* Willingness to travel roughly 40–50%, mainly across EMEA, with some APAC and AMER travel, including evening/weekend work around live events.
*Cybersecurity or enterprise software experience is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is commercial judgement, regional ownership, and exceptional execution.*
## **Preferred**
* Experience with event and marketing technology such as Asana, Allocadia, Coupa, Jifflenow, Cvent, Salesforce, Sigma, Splash, RainFocus, Claude, and Google Suite.
* An additional European language.
* Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) principles and target-account event strategies.
## **The Ideal Candidate**
You know a great event is not a logistics exercise. It's a story told in three dimensions — one that brings a brand to life, earns trust with prospects and customers, arms the sales team, and produces measurable business impact.
You're equally at home building a project plan in a spreadsheet and troubleshooting a badge-printer jam at 7am. You're calm when things go sideways, direct when something isn't working, and generous with your stakeholders when it goes right.
Most of all, you care about the craft. The details other people don't notice are exactly the ones you fix.
## **What Success Looks Like**
* Your events are delivered flawlessly and consistently
* Registrations, attendance, meetings and pipeline consistently hit or beat plan for the events you own.
* Budgets and vendor relationships are managed with discipline and transparency.
* Every event has a clear measurement story and a defensible ROI.

# Job: Head of Finance
**Key responsibilities**
* Financial Strategy & Sustainability – Work with the Treasurer, Finance Subgroup and Board on financial strategy, reserves policy and long-term sustainability planning.
* Reporting & Accountability – Produce timely management accounts, forecasts and reports for the Board, CE, managers and funders — translating complex information into clear advice for non-specialists.
* Statutory Compliance – Lead preparation of annual accounts to Charity SORP, oversee audit completion, and ensure all regulatory returns are submitted on time.
* Financial Planning & Control – Lead budget-setting, maintain financial controls and audit trails, monitor cash flow and flag issues early.
* Financial Operations – Oversee payroll, payment administration, bank reconciliations and tax compliance.
* Management Support – Build managers' confidence in budgeting, people management and compliance, providing accessible support for day-to-day and complex issues alike.
* HR – Ensure HR systems, policies and records are compliant with employment law.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement – Design and maintain systems that are efficient, userfriendly and reduce administrative burden.
* Risk & Governance – Contribute to risk management and ensure appropriate insurance, contracts and financial safeguards are in place.
We're looking for someone who combines real technical expertise with a genuine commitment to the values that drive Macc's work. This is a senior role requiring both depth of knowledge and the ability to use it in service of an organisation whose purpose is to strengthen communities. That combination matters as much as the qualifications.
You'll need a strong financial background — ideally as a qualified or part-qualified accountant with experience in the charity sector, including a working understanding of restricted funds, grant finance and Charity SORP. Technical knowledge alone isn't enough: you'll need to be able to translate complex financial information into clear, accessible advice for managers, trustees and others who aren't finance specialists. Making the numbers understandable and useful is a core part of the job.
This role also has oversight of our HR Lead so we're looking for someone who's comfortable holding this. You don't need to be a specialist but you'll need to approach our role as an employer with the same values-led mindset we bring to everything else — embedding equity and inclusion in practice, not just in policy.
This is a role that requires sound judgement and a high degree of integrity. You'll be handling sensitive financial and people-related information, advising the Chief Executive and Board, and supporting managers across the organisation. People will need to feel they can rely on your advice and come to you with difficult questions. Building and maintaining that trust will be central to how you work.
Strong communication skills are essential. You'll be producing financial reports and HR papers for the Board and its subgroups, supporting managers who may be less confident in financial or people management, and helping embed systems that work for everyone. Being clear, patient and accessible in how you communicate will matter as much as being accurate.
We want Macc to lead by example — as an employer, as a financial steward and as a values-based organisation. We're looking for someone who sees good governance and inclusive practice not as administrative obligations, but as part of what it means to do this work well.
This role will suit someone who's energised by the breadth of it — finance and HR, strategic and operational, specialist and generalist. If bringing rigour, integrity and a genuine commitment to equity to a community organisation sounds like the right challenge for you, we'd love to hear from you.
You need to be willing and able to travel around Manchester — though driving ability is not essential as we encourage use of public transport and active travel.

If you’re excited by this role and believe you can bring to it the skills and passion we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s how our recruitment process works:
1: Application form
On our website is a short application form in which we ask you for some basic details and a few questions about your skills, knowledge and relevant experience. There is also an equalities monitoring form with simple questions and a privacy statement which we ask you to confirm you have read. Once you’ve completed the form, please email it to: rabia@macc.org.uk
We acknowledge all applications by e-mail (or post if email is not available) within 2 working days of receipt. If you don’t receive an acknowledgement, please contact us as soon as possible: if you haven’t heard from us, we may not have received your application.
2: Rolling recruitment
As this is our second round of recruitment for this position, we will be running a “rolling” process. This means that instead of a single closing date, we're reviewing applications in rounds as they come in. Applications received by 12pm midday 30th October 2026 will be reviewed together as our 2nd round. Interviews for this round are scheduled for 25th November 2026. If we don't appoint from that round, we'll keep the vacancy open and review further applications every [10 working days] after that.
All applications are assessed against the same criteria, so you're always compared fairly against what we’re looking for – applying a bit later doesn't put you at a disadvantage. The vacancy will close as soon as we appoint someone, which could happen before every round has taken place. If that happens while your application is still waiting to be reviewed, we'll let you know as soon as we can.
Our advice is if you're interested, don't wait – apply as soon as you're ready.
3: Interviews
We will review all the applications we receive and may choose to hold a short informal
conversation with shortlisted candidates. This is held online and helps us make the final decision about who to invite for a formal in-person interview.
In-person interviews are usually held at our offices at St Thomas Centre in Ardwick. The interviews gives us a chance to explore your application in more detail – and also for you to ask us questions about the role and our organisation. We may ask you to prepare a task in advance if that’s appropriate for the role.
If you are invited to interview, we’ll give you a copy of the questions when you arrive so you can have a few minutes to prepare your thoughts. After the interview we also give you an opportunity to share any feedback – or make a note of anything you forgot to mention.

# Sr. Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
London, UK
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
#### **The Role**
The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.
As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.
This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.
Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
#### **What You'll Do**
* Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production
* Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows
* Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific
* Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality
* Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features
* Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)
* Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance
#### **Who You Are**
* Extensive professional software engineering experience
* Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)
* Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs
* Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)
* You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.
* A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.
* You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience
#### **Nice to Have**
* Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)
* Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)
* Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments
* Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality
**Our Values**
* **Act Like an Owner -** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together -** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients -** Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation -** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning -** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.
In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

As a Technical Lead Learning Experience Designer (LED), you will be responsible for designing, developing, and contextualizing high-quality GA learning programs for enterprise, technical, and professional audiences. Because AI is increasingly embedded across GA programs and client needs, you should understand how modern AI tools are actually used in the workplace and be able to translate that fluency into applied activities, labs, simulations, facilitator guides, assessments, and client-specific adaptations.

The core responsibility is to create scalable, high-quality GA programs that meet learner needs, client goals, market expectations, and GA’s instructional standards.
You will project manage and collaborate with subject matter experts, instructors, product managers, learning designers, assessment specialists, vendors, and client-facing teams to create learning experiences that reflect current market needs, emerging capabilities, and practical workplace application.

* This role will be 100% remote

aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, Aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.
We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we’re building the next generation of enterprise AI and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us scale.
We're hiring a product designer for whom UX and UI are one craft. You take a vague problem to a flow that feels obvious, then to screens where every pixel, word and transition is placed on purpose. The bar is software that feels inevitable: nothing missing, nothing extra, nothing a pixel out of place.
What you'll do
Turn ambiguous problems into clear flows, information architecture and interaction models.
Design every state of every screen: empty, loading, partial, error and the edge cases nobody listed.
Own the visual layer: typography, layout, colour, iconography and hierarchy.
Specify interactions and motion precisely enough that engineers ship them as designed.
Build and evolve the design system.
Review what ships at 1× and 2×, and catch the 1 px misalignment, the wrong easing and the clipped label before anyone else does.
Test with real users and iterate until nothing is left to remove.
UX
6+ years in product design, with complex products shipped end to end.
User research: interviews, contextual inquiry and usability testing, planned and run yourself and turned into decisions.
Problem framing: user needs, jobs to be done and success measures defined before any screen is drawn.
End-to-end journeys: journey maps and service blueprints covering every touchpoint, handoff and failure path.
Task flows and wireframes that account for every branch, edge case and error, tested before visual design.
Information architecture: content models, navigation and labelling, validated with card sorts and tree tests.
Interaction design: mental models, affordances, feedback and system status, consistent across the product.
Evaluation: heuristic reviews and usability metrics such as task success, time on task and error rate.
UI
Visual hierarchy: one clear focal point per screen, built with scale, weight, contrast and space rather than decoration.
Typography: type scales, optical sizes, tracking that tightens as type grows, tabular figures, and layouts that hold up at larger text sizes.
Layout: grids, a strict spacing scale, every edge on the pixel grid, and optical corrections where the measurements are right but the result looks wrong.
Colour: semantic colour systems for light and dark themes, and perceptually even palettes in OKLCH or Display P3.
Depth and materials: elevation, shadows, translucency and blur, continuous corner curves and concentric radii, used to show what is interactive and what sits on top of what.
Component states: default, hover, pressed, focus, selected, disabled, loading and error, designed for every component.
Design systems: primitive and semantic tokens, variables and modes, components with real variants, and documentation teams use.
Iconography: a consistent grid, stroke and corner language, with icons drawn to read at small sizes.
Motion: springs rather than fixed durations; fluid, interruptible motion that follows the finger and keeps its momentum on release; clear choreography of what moves first, what follows and what leaves.
Platform conventions: deep knowledge of desktop, web and mobile patterns, and the judgement to know when to break them.
Accessibility designed in from the start to WCAG 2.2 AA: contrast, focus order, larger text, reduced motion and screen-reader labels.
Tools
Figma at expert level: variables and modes, component properties, auto layout, advanced prototyping and Figma Motion.
After Effects, Rive or ProtoPie when an interaction has to be felt, not described.
Designing for AI
Interfaces for output that is non-deterministic, streamed and sometimes wrong.
Patterns that keep people in control: review, correction, undo and honest failure states.
Trust built through clarity, not decoration.
Good to have
Illustration, iconography or brand identity work.
Industrial, print or type design, where tolerances are unforgiving.
Dense professional tools: editors, dashboards, developer products.
Public work: writing, talks or side projects.
Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy.
Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally.
Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions.
Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits.

**What do we do?**
Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.
We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.
**The Role:**
We are looking for an exceptional Staff Product Manager to lead our flagship Checkout experience – the most strategically critical, highest-visibility product surface at Paddle. Every dollar our customers earn flows through Checkout. This is a massive-scale engine: we handle **~10 million sessions a month**, processing **$180M+ in monthly payments** across a global network of **10,000+ sellers**.
The decisions made here directly move the needle on conversion, revenue, and customer trust. This is the toughest product role at Paddle, and we're looking for someone who is energised by that.
You will own the Checkout product end-to-end: its strategy, its roadmap, its performance, and its commercial outcomes. You'll operate as the senior product voice in the room with our executive team, engineering leaders, and largest customers, and you'll be expected to set the bar – not just for what we ship, but for how the wider product org makes decisions, runs discovery, and uses data.
You'll work in a trio with a strong engineering lead and an experienced product designer, with daily exposure to Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Risk, Finance, and Exco. Given the cross-functional intensity of the work, this role requires regular in-person collaboration with the Checkout team and the wider Payments group.
This is an opportunity for a staff-level operator who wants to own a product that genuinely matters – one with hard technical problems, real commercial stakes, and the platform to influence company strategy.
**What you'll do:**
Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:
* Own the long-term vision and strategy for Checkout, grounded in market trends, payments innovation, customer needs, and Paddle's commercial goals. Translate this into a roadmap you can defend at Exco and to customers.
* Make – and stand behind – the tough prioritisation calls. Navigate ambiguous, multi-stakeholder trade-offs where the "right" answer requires deep judgement across technical constraints, commercial impact, compliance, and UX.
* Set the bar for discovery and prioritisation across the wider Payments group; coach other PMs on how to do this well.
Product Development & Delivery:
* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-faceted initiatives without needing oversight. Define and enforce the delivery standards (discovery, specs, experimentation, launch quality) that the rest of the product team operates against.
* Work in a tight trio with engineering and design to ship fast, instrument well, and iterate based on real customer signal. Use AI tooling to compress the loop from idea to spec to prototype – we expect ideas to be testable in days, not weeks.
* Run a continuous programme of optimisation – A/B tests, beta programmes, usability research – to compound conversion and UX gains across a high-volume, consumer-facing surface.
Data, Metrics & Commercial Impact:
* Own the KPIs that matter for Checkout (conversion, authorisation rates, revenue impact, NPS, etc.) and weave them into the strategic narrative for the business.
* Dive into data independently. We don't expect you to wait for an analyst; we expect you to pull the numbers (with AI help where it accelerates you), form a hypothesis, and bring a recommendation.
* Use product data to influence business strategy beyond your immediate roadmap – pricing, GTM, risk policy, settlement, etc.
Stakeholder Management & Storytelling:
* Align senior stakeholders – including Exco, Sales leadership, and key customers – around the Checkout strategy. Tailor the message, never the substance.
* Craft compelling written narratives. At staff level we expect your docs to be the artefact that drives decisions, not a deck or a meeting.
* Be a credible technical partner to engineering on complex payments, integrations, and platform decisions.
GTM & Customer Proximity:
* Oversee GTM for Checkout launches across multiple customer segments and geographies, working with Marketing, Sales, Solutions, and Support.
* Shape the customer-centric culture of the team – consistently in front of customers yourself, and building the processes that keep the rest of the team close to them too.
**We'd love to hear from you if you:**
* You're used to owning a high-stakes, high-complexity product end-to-end with clear, measurable business impact – or you're a senior PM who is unambiguously operating beyond your title.
* You have specific, hands-on experience with payments, checkout, or comparable consumer-facing fintech experiences at scale. You understand auth rates, 3DS, SCA, PSP economics, fraud trade-offs, etc.
* You've worked on high-volume, consumer-facing products where small UX or technical changes have outsized commercial impact, and you can talk through specific wins you've owned.
* You're technically credible – comfortable in the details with engineers, able to reason about systems, APIs, and trade-offs without needing them to translate.
* You're data-fluent and metrics-led. You don't believe a thing until you've seen the numbers, and you can run your own analysis end-to-end.
* You use AI as a daily force multiplier – for research, writing, analysis, and building functional prototypes – and can show specific examples of how it's changed the quality and speed of your output. You'll be working alongside engineers and designers who are pushing the same boundary.
* You've built and shipped in scale-up or startup environments, including zero-to-one work. You're at home with ambiguity, not blocked by it.
* You're an outstanding written and verbal communicator – English is your primary working language, and your writing changes minds.

## About the role
You'll build the systems that make reinforcement learning work at frontier scale — coupling policy optimization with large fleets of inference workers, agentic environments, and the reward and verification systems that turn model behavior into learning signal. RL is how Luma's models go from capable to useful. RL at scale is a full-loop systems problem: training, rollout generation, environment execution, and reward computation running concurrently across thousands of GPUs, all needing to stay fast, stable, and correct together. It fits someone who has lived this — post-trained LLMs with RL, built environments and verifiers, and debugged asynchronous rollout pipelines at scale. If you haven't operated RL at real scale, this will be deep water.
**What You'll Own**
* Design, build, and scale distributed RL post-training systems, orchestrating trainer, rollout, environment, and reward workloads across thousands of GPUs.
* Build high-throughput rollout generation, integrating inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), weight synchronization, and asynchronous/off-policy schemes.
* Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks — sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction — reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes.
* Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking.
* Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable.
* Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers.
**First 90 Days**
*One way the first 90 could unfold.*
* **Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose:** Learn the current RL stack and where throughput, stability, or correctness break.
* **Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate:** Improve a piece of the loop (rollout throughput, reward infra, or an environment) and prove it on a real run.
* **Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize:** Harden the full loop across thousands of GPUs and asynchronous architectures.
**What You Bring**
* Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with RL (PPO/GRPO-family, RLHF, RLVR) at meaningful scale.
* Extensive distributed PyTorch training and parallelism (FSDP, Tensor/Pipeline/Expert Parallel) for foundation models.
* Experience building RL environments, reward functions, verifiers, or evaluation harnesses for LLM agents, including sandboxed execution and multi-turn tool use.
* Deep familiarity with RL post-training frameworks (veRL, OpenRLHF, TRL, Ray orchestration) and rollout inference engines (vLLM, SGLang).
* Strong understanding of GPU clusters, networking, and communication libraries (NCCL, MPI) under mixed training and inference workloads.
**Nice to Have**
* Running RL training across 100+ GPUs, including asynchronous or disaggregated trainer/rollout architectures.
* Containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, Ray) for large environment fleets and sandboxed workloads.
* Research contributions in RL for LLMs, or open-source contributions to RL training frameworks.

# Global Capital Markets 2027, Off-Cycle Analyst (Debt Capital Markets) - London

**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognising and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
**The team:**
At Bank of America, our Global Capital Markets (GCM) business comprises our Debt Capital Markets (DCM), Equity Capital Markets (ECM), Leveraged Finance (LevFin), and Sustainable Solutions Group (SSG) businesses. In all of these businesses we assist our clients in accessing and navigating the financial markets and provide tailored capital markets solutions to address a broad range of objectives. Across the four groups, our clients include investment grade and sub-investment grade corporates, financial institutions, private equity firms and sovereign, supranational and sovereign (SSA) issuers.
This London-based internship will be within DCM, which products include bonds, loans, capital products, liability management and FX and rates solutions.
**Programme Overview**
Our Off-Cycle Analyst programme is designed to offer you a broad and exciting experience of what it is like to work as a full time Capital Markets analyst. For applications to this London programme, if successful you will be assigned to the DCM team. Analysts in DCM business, within our GCM team, are involved in originating and executing a wide variety of debt solutions for our clients. The DCM team advise a broad client base which includes corporates, financial institutions, and sovereign, supranational and sovereign (SSA) issuers in both developed and emerging markets across EMEA. Specifically, we focus on advisory, structuring and execution solutions for our clients seeking to raise new debt financing using a broad range of products to achieve their objectives. You will work with our GCM partners, in addition to our Corporate and Investment bankers, to support clients by advising on optimal methods to access financing, whether for acquisitions, general financing or strengthening of balance sheets.
**Training and Development**
Your training and development is our top priority with extensive formal training offered at the start of the programme in addition to on the job support, educational speaker events and mentorship throughout.
**Responsibilities:**
As an off-cycle analyst, your key tasks and responsibilities may include but are not limited to:
* Assist DCM professionals with deal origination and execution across a diverse range of product areas
* Work as a product specialist directly with our clients at top management level to create and deliver financing solutions through DCM (bonds, loans, FX and rates) products
* Develop a strong understanding of market fundamentals and be able to make market-informed contributions on a broad array of financing strategies that address clients’ specific needs
* Design highly tailored presentations for clients to outline solutions to their financing needs (including for bank clients to meet their regulatory capital requirements and optimise their capital stacks)
* Work on live transactions and interact with clients and professionals from across the bank as you build your network and experience
* Work closely with Investment Banking and Corporate Banking teams on client coverage and origination, and with the broader GCM team advising on holistic financing solutions Work with sales teams and traders in Global Markets to coordinate and manage live deal executions, and liaise with Global Research to stay informed on the latest market developments
**Eligibility**
* Candidates are required to have already received or be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited college or university.
+ For candidates who have already graduated, the graduation date **must be after January 2026**.
+ For candidates who are still pursuing a degree, the completion time frame **must be before July 2027.** Completion means that you have completed all final exams, coursework, and have no outstanding requirements for graduation. Please note that we reserve the right to request evidence of this completion date before extending an offer.
* On track for a minimum 2:1 degree classification or equivalent
Candidates must be available to join the programme from Monday 11th January 2027 for a period of four months with an option to extend it by 2 months. If candidates were to receive a full-time offer, then they **must be available to join the graduate programme from July 2027.** Please note that we are unable to offer any deferred start dates.
**What we are looking for:**
* Fluency in English is essential, proficiency in any European language would be highly desirable.
* Applications are accepted from a diverse range of degree disciplines such as the arts and humanities, as well as numerically focused subjects such as economics, mathematics, science and engineering

Translate Responsible AI governance requirements into onboarding content, communications, workshops and scalable digital learning programmes that build awareness, support adoption and reinforce responsible AI practices across the organisation.

# Marketing Insight & Analytics Manager
**Marketing Insight & Analytics Manager – Maternity Cover**
Marketing Effectiveness & Analytics | Fixed-term contract (c. 12 months)
Join the team at the heart of understanding how marketing activity drives commercial performance across Awaze’s portfolio of brands. As Marketing Insight & Analytics Manager, you will be the analytical engine behind two connected areas of the team: commercial marketing insight – how our marketing plan, targets, and forecasts are tracking – and marketing performance insight – what is driving movements in bookings, revenue, and paid media efficiency, and why.
You will support the Marketing Effectiveness & Analytics lead providing the hands-on analysis, reporting, and investigation that keeps both areas running through a period of maternity cover. You will become the team’s go-to expert on our marketing database and dashboards – the person who knows what the data means, which metrics matter, and how to get from a question to an answer. This is a broad, hands-on, mid-level role, with the Marketing Effectiveness & Analytics lead providing context, and ownership of senior stakeholder decisions.
**Your mission**
Reporting directly to the Marketing Analytics & Effectiveness Lead, you will ensure the business has a trusted, commercially meaningful view of marketing performance. You will own the accuracy, consistency and interpretation of marketing performance reporting and analytical outputs, getting beneath movements in bookings, revenue and channel efficiency to explain what changed, why it changed and what action should follow.
You will work closely with the Senior Marketing Analytics Manager, who leads strategic commercial planning, the bottom-up forecast and the senior performance narrative. Your role is to provide the analytical depth behind this work: understanding what is genuinely happening within each channel, identifying the drivers of performance and providing the evidence and insight that shape strategic recommendations.
This goes beyond producing reports or completing predefined analysis. You will independently identify the questions that matter, determine the analysis required, challenge misleading or incomplete interpretations, and turn complex marketing, customer and commercial data into clear implications and recommended actions for stakeholders across Paid Media, Finance and Commercial.
**What you’ll be doing**
***Marketing database & insight***
• Become the team’s go-to expert on the marketing performance cube and its supporting dashboards, which bring together tracked performance metrics such as sessions, bookings, channel activity and booking behaviour. Understand how the data is structured, how each metric is defined and how to use it to answer commercial performance questions.
• Guide the wider team on reporting – advising on the right metrics to report, how to interpret them, and where reported numbers can mislead
• Use the marketing performance cube to identify what is driving changes across brands, channels, source markets, destinations and regions; translate the findings into clear commercial implications and recommended actions, working with the relevant teams to track whether those actions improve performance.
• Diagnose movements in sessions, bookings, conversion, revenue, spend, contribution, CPB, IPB, and ROI, separating genuine performance drivers from normal volatility and reporting noise
• Analyse audience profiles, customer behaviour, and market trends to identify shifts in demand – and what they mean for where and how we market
• Evaluate campaigns and marketing efficiency, connecting paid media activity with demand, seasonality, pricing, and availability
• Reconcile differences between platform reporting, GA4, attribution outputs, and internal bookings and revenue data, flagging where tracking or methodology may distort conclusions
• Investigate ad hoc performance, trading, channel, and campaign questions from across Marketing, Finance, and Commercial
***Go To Market, Forecasting & commercial planning support***
• Own the quarterly Go to Market (GTM) planning process, setting the timetable, coordinating inputs across Marketing and ensuring plans, budgets, targets and assumptions are brought together into a clear and consistent cross-brand view.
• Use insight from the marketing performance cube to build the evidence base for each GTM cycle, identifying the channel, customer, source-market and booking trends that should shape marketing priorities.
• Work with the Senior Marketing Analytics Manager, brand teams and channel leads to translate performance insight into marketing strategy, challenging assumptions and highlighting the opportunities, risks and trade-offs that need to be addressed.
• Support the Senior Marketing Analytics Manager in validating the bottom-up marketing forecast against current channel performance, flagging early where emerging signals suggest that bookings, spend or efficiency assumptions are over- or under-stated.
• Maintain accurate working views of the marketing forecast and commercial plan, sourcing the required inputs, reconciling inconsistencies and ensuring the numbers reflect the latest performance outlook.
• Track delivery against agreed marketing plans, targets, CPBs and ROAS thresholds, identifying material risks and opportunities and recommending where plans may need to change.
• Prepare the analysis, narrative and supporting materials for Go to Market sessions and regular Finance playbacks, including variance analysis, performance drivers and clear evidence behind proposed actions.
***Reporting, measurement & ways of working***
• Run the trading and marketing reporting cadence – daily, weekly, and month-to-date views
• Maintain and improve dashboards, trading views, and automated reporting so they surface the drivers behind performance, not just top-line metrics
• Ensure performance media data is accurate across all brands and channels – validating that spend, relative impact, and business effect are captured correctly
• Use automation and AI tools where appropriate to reduce manual reporting effort and increase the speed and quality of insight delivery
• Deliver deep-dive analysis that informs marketing plans – using your command of the marketing database to move from question to insight to recommendation
**Who we’re looking for**
You enjoy getting under the skin of performance data, asking commercial questions, and turning analysis into something people can act on. You are comfortable working across two workstreams with competing priorities, taking direction from two leads, and managing your own workload. You are naturally curious, highly numerate, and confident presenting what you find.
**You’ll bring:**
• Solid experience analysing marketing, digital, or commercial performance in a high-volume, multi-channel business
• Strong Excel and analytical skills, with confidence in reporting tools such as Tableau, GA4, Looker Studio, or Power BI
• Genuine data literacy: you quickly learn how a marketing database is structured and become the go-to person on its metrics and definitions
• Working knowledge of digital channel performance – spend, traffic, conversion, CPB, ROAS – across PPC, SEO, Social, and CRM, with the credibility to discuss it with channel managers
• Experience tracking performance against targets, forecasts, and prior-year benchmarks, with the commercial judgement to separate what is material from what is noise
• Clear written and verbal communication – you can turn analysis into a narrative that lands with both technical and non-technical audiences
• Strong analytical interpretation and communication skills: you can move beyond reporting what the numbers say to explain why performance has changed, what it means commercially and what action should follow, articulating the story clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• A proactive, organised approach to managing competing priorities across two workstreams
**Nice to have:**
• Exposure to marketing measurement techniques – incrementality testing, attribution modelling, or marketing mix modelling
• SQL or database querying skills, or experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, Python, or automated reporting pipelines
• Background in travel, e-commerce, or other high-volume, multi-inventory consumer businesses
**How you’ll make an impact**
• Keep insight and reporting continuity through the cover period – stakeholders in Paid Media, Finance, and Commercial notice no drop in quality or speed
• Give the two leads a trusted analytical partner: accurate working forecast views, well-evidenced channel narratives, early risk flags, and playback materials that stand up to challenge
• Become the recognised expert on the marketing database – the person the team trusts on which metrics to report and what the numbers actually mean
• Establish trusted marketing data for the broader teams – one accurate, consistent view of spend, impact, and performance that Marketing, Finance, and Commercial can build plans on
• Move dashboards and reporting from describing results to explaining drivers and implications
• Reduce manual reporting effort through better automation and repeatable insight workflows
**Why you’ll want to work at Awaze**
We offer a versatile position in a strong professional and social environment, one you’ll have the opportunity to influence and help shape. You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.
We’re a people-first business, and we know that our success starts with our teams.
Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll enjoy:
• Generous discounts on holidays across our brands
• Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best
• Unusual breadth for a fixed-term role: exposure to commercial planning, forecasting, paid media measurement, and marketing effectiveness in a single seat
**About Awaze**
Our mission is clear – to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.
With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.
As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next – powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.
**Worth knowing**
We offer the best of both worlds: the energy of the office and the freedom of home, with hybrid working that lets you have a mix of office and remote work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

* Ensures all change management activities follow PMO methodologies and templates.

Our 4-year AI and Data Science Graduate Apprenticeship gives you the opportunity to contribute to some of the UK’s most important defence programmes, all while working towards a BSc (Hons) degree and building a rewarding career in Data Analytics.
 
 
 
About the programme 
 
This is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience supporting major programmes, including the Royal Navy’s Type 31 frigates and the UK Submarine Dismantling Programme. You’ll contribute to the delivery, maintenance, and transformation of some of the UK’s most advanced naval platforms while developing an understanding of how data and analytics support decision-making across complex, large-scale programmes.
 
Your work will help optimise operations, reduce risk, and enhance the performance of critical assets. You’ll explore the full data lifecycle, from sourcing and cleansing datasets to identifying trends and presenting insights through clear, compelling visualisations. This could involve building Power BI reports, carrying out statistical analysis, or creating dashboards that help teams monitor performance, make informed decisions, and identify opportunities for greater efficiency.
 
You’ll gain valuable experience with our enterprise systems and contribute to projects that enhance how data is captured, managed, and used across the business. Depending on your placement, you may also support the development of customer-facing applications and data solutions using Palantir Foundry, enabling smarter, faster decision-making.
 
Working alongside experienced colleagues and supported by dedicated mentors, you’ll quickly build your confidence and capability. You’ll learn how to communicate insights effectively, challenge assumptions with evidence, and bring fresh perspectives to complex problems. From driving innovation to influencing decision-making, you’ll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of our programmes and the way we work.
 
 
 
Your education/training 
 
As part of your apprenticeship, you'll study towards a BSc (Hons) in AI and Data Science through Glasgow Caledonian University, combining academic learning with practical experience in the workplace.
 
Our apprenticeship programme follows the proven 70:20:10 development model, giving you the ideal balance of experience, support and formal learning:
 
70% workplace experience: Rotate through placements and contribute to real projects and programmes.
20% coaching and mentoring: Learn from experienced professionals who will guide and support your development.
10% formal learning: Work towards a recognised postgraduate qualification alongside your role.
 
By the end of the programme, you'll have developed a strong foundation in AI and Data Science disciplines, practical business knowledge, and the skills needed to build a successful long-term career in Data Analytics.
 
 
 
Future prospects   
Upon successful completion of the programme, you'll be ready to step into a Data Analyst or Continuous Improvement role, with a competitive salary of up to £39,000.
 
From there, your development doesn’t stop. Through the Babcock Role Framework, you’ll have a clear view of how your career can progress, with mapped-out pathways, development opportunities and the tools you need to get wherever you want to go.
 
 
 
What you’ll need   
UCAS Tariff: 96 points.
Scottish Highers: BBCC or equivalent, including Maths or Computing.
We also accept:
Relevant Foundation Apprenticeships (counting as one Higher at grade B), in combination with SQA Highers.
Modern Apprenticeship at SCQF Level 6 in a related subject (equivalent to two Highers at B), in combination with SQA Highers.
You must be resident in Scotland, as Graduate Apprenticeships are only available to individuals living and working in Scotland.
This role requires on-site attendance. By your start date, you must be able to reliably commute to the site. This will normally require living within a reasonable commuting distance of Rosyth or relocating before you join us.
Many of our programmes are subject to Security Clearance and Trade Control restrictions which mean that your place of birth, nationality, citizenship, or residency you hold or have held may impact which programmes you are eligible for. For this programme, you must be able to achieve and maintain Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Check (SC) security clearance. For further details, visit GOV.UK and search ‘United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels’.
Under applicable national security legislation, this post may only be occupied by a UK national. This legal requirement is independent of our recruitment policies, and all eligible applicants will be assessed fairly and without discrimination.    
 
 
 
What you’ll get  
We’ll provide you with a supportive and engaging environment where you can grow your career.
 
In addition, you’ll benefit from:
 
Fully funded qualification
Personal development training and opportunities
Minimum 28 days holiday allowance including bank holidays
Competitive pension scheme
Employee share scheme
Flexible benefits including cycle to work scheme and employee shopping savings portal
 
You’ll also have the chance to get involved in our STEM outreach activities and volunteering opportunities, which our apprentices find incredibly rewarding.
 
 
 
Your career development
 
It’s hard to beat the variety of fantastic opportunities and business experiences you’ll receive. You can expect real world encounters and exposure to exciting projects that will really help you navigate where you want to take your career.
 
Plus, when you join us, you’ll be automatically enrolled onto our Apprentice Development Programme. Through a series of digital and face to face sessions, presented by wellbeing and performance experts and our external partners, we will equip you with the knowledge and tools you need to thrive and perform at your very best on your programme and beyond.
 
 
 
Application process and important information
 
Applications are reviewed in the order they are received, and if there’s a high level of interest in this programme, we may close applications earlier than advertised. To give yourself the best chance of being considered, we recommend submitting your application and completing any required online assessments as soon as possible.

## Job Description
**LEEDS BASED.**
**Prudential Policy Directorate**
The Prudential Policy Directorate (PPD) is responsible for designing, negotiating internationally and implementing effective prudential regulation in order to remove or reduce systemic risks, promote the safety and soundness of PRA-regulated firms and ensure appropriate protection for insurance policyholders. PPD supports both the Prudential Regulation Committee (PRC) and Financial Policy Committee (FPC) in fulfilling their objectives.
**Prudential Framework Division**
The Prudential Framework Division promotes financial stability and resilience in a changing world by working with others to deliver world class banking prudential policy and thought leadership.
We do this by shaping, maintaining the integrity of, and explaining the capital frameworks, macroprudential toolkit, liquidity policy, FSCS protection and the regulatory perimeter including considering innovation.
The division plays an active role in policy development, implementation, evaluation, and horizon scanning. It does this through close collaboration with staff across the Bank, externally with HM Treasury, the Financial Conduct Authority and the Financial Services Compensation Scheme. Analysis and research are undertaken across the Division to ensure that the Bank stays at the forefront of the intellectual debate on prudential policy.
This role will sit in the Innovation and Regulatory Perimeter Team (IRP).
**Innovation and Regulatory Perimeter team**
The IRP Team is responsible for considering how to apply and amend prudential policy frameworks and the regulatory perimeter to innovations by PRA regulated firms. The team seeks to do this in a way that facilitates, subject to international standards and the PRA’s primary objectives, the international competitiveness of the UK economy—particularly financial services—and its medium- to long-term growth. To date, the team has focussed on banking policy for innovations in digital money and digital assets both domestically and internationally.

This is a permanent opportunity for a Lead Policy Analyst at Scale F within the Innovation and Regulatory Policy Team.
