Oxford, England, United Kingdom
**About IonQ:**
IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance. Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.
**Location:** Oxford, England **Travel:** As needed **Job ID:** 1905
**The Role:**
We are looking for a Technical Programme Manager to join the Quantum Systems Infrastructure (QSI) team at IonQ's Oxford office. QSI builds and runs the platform our next-generation quantum computers are built, tested, released and operated on, from bare metal in the lab to cloud, working across both Oxford and the US.
Your mission is to run the machinery that keeps QSI’s portfolio visible, planned and unblocked so engineers can engineer, leaders can lead, and the business always knows what is changing and why it matters. You will work very closely with the Technical Programme Managers in the Software and Science teams, ensuring our processes and workflows complement and integrate with their work, rather than duplicating effort.
We run a centralised PMO operating model at IonQ which you will be a core part of though on a day to day basis you will work alongside the QSI team. As part of this model, this role will not make technical decisions, own engineering headcount, or define product but it will make the programme around those things run.
**Responsibilities**:
You will own programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams, translating a leadership-visible roadmap into clear plans, measurable milestones and predictable delivery. You will create and run the operating rhythm that keeps teams aligned and leaders informed. When priorities shift, you will implement structure to that ambiguity, clarifying scope, coordinating trade-offs and pushing problems to resolution.
Key responsibilities include:
* Owning programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams: one planning rhythm, one backlog discipline, ensuring dependencies and risks surfaced early and chased to resolution.
* Running the roadmap-to-delivery link: keeping the roadmap, Jira and reality agreeing with each other, and making slippage visible early.
* Owning the programme ceremonies and the design of the workflows behind them (day-to-day stand-ups are run by the engineering managers).
* Working hand-in-hand with the Software and Science TPMs: shared or integrated processes wherever teams interact, and no duplicated ceremonies, boards or reporting.
* Coordinating across teams - Continuing Engineering (US), the PMO, product and science teams - serving as QSI’s cross-functional programme liaison.
* Establishing programme cadences and reporting (changelogs, demos, leadership summaries etc) in plain English that non-infrastructure stakeholders can read and trust.
* Running the intake and triage process so requests reach the right stream with the right priority, without engineers being interrupt-driven.
**Requirements:**
We’re looking for a technically fluent Programme Manager who brings structure, pace and clarity to a fast-moving infrastructure organisation. You will be comfortable working in a deeply technical environment, working daily with platform and systems engineers, while translating progress, risks and trade-offs into clear reporting senior stakeholders can trust. You will thrive in ambiguity and an organisation where you are able to drive change. You do not just coordinate: you unblock teams, keep plans honest, and raise the bar on how programmes are run.
You will have prior experience tunning technical programmes across multiple engineering teams, ideally in infrastructure, platform or systems engineering environments. You should be fluent with modern programme tooling, such as Jira, Confluence and GitHub, and have the judgement to keep process lightweight.
You’d be a great fit with:
* Experience harmonising ways of working across sibling teams or departments, integrating processes rather than multiplying them.
* Strong, plain-English communication and the ability to make infrastructure work legible to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across sites and time zones in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* A chase-without-nagging, escalate-without-drama working style, and a clear sense of the difference between a risk and a noise.
Additional experience would be beneficial, such as a background in hardware-adjacent software (labs, manufacturing, robotics, scientific instruments), exposure to regulated or government-customer delivery, or agile coaching / scrum mastery experience. Working knowledge of quantum computing concepts would be a plus though is not essential.
**Benefits:**
Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.
We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.
Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.

This role offers the opportunity to work within an innovative and evolving service that focuses on building family strengths, preventing escalation of need and creating sustainable change for children and their families.
Working within a trauma-informed and motivational framework, you will support families to identify what matters most to them, build on their existing strengths and access the support they need to overcome challenges and improve outcomes.

As a Family Help Family Support Practitioner, you will provide timely, flexible and responsive support to children, young people and their families, ensuring that help is delivered at the earliest opportunity to prevent difficulties from escalating.
You will hold and manage a caseload of families with a wide range of needs, from those requiring practical support and advice to families experiencing multiple and complex challenges. Working in partnership with children, parents, carers and partner agencies, you will undertake whole-family assessments, identify strengths and needs, and develop Family Help plans that are outcome-focused and family-led.
The role involves delivering direct support through home visits, community-based interventions, Family Hubs and Children's Centres, adapting your approach to meet the needs of individual families. You will engage wider family members, community resources and professional networks to strengthen protective factors and build family resilience.
You will work collaboratively with education, health, social care and voluntary sector partners to coordinate support, monitor progress and ensure that families receive the right help at the right time. This role sits within a locality-based Family Help Team, operating from our Best Start Family Hubs and Children's Centres. Family Hubs are at the centre of our vision to provide accessible, joined-up support for children, young people and families, ensuring services are delivered collaboratively and are responsive to local needs.
Our teams provide universal, targeted and intensive support to families, offering advice, guidance and practical interventions, as well as longer-term work with families experiencing multiple and complex needs. We are committed to helping children thrive, strengthening family relationships and supporting communities to become more resilient.

children and families. We particularly welcome applications from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic candidates to help ensure our workforce reflects and understands the diverse communities we serve.

You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers. **This is the role described here.**

As our internal audit manager, you’ll play a vital role in this transformation by leading and delivering internal audits across Ki and Ki Syndicate 1618. You’ll focus on critical technology and IT audits—including technology change, data governance, software development, algorithmic underwriting, machine learning, cloud, cybersecurity, and information security. You’ll also support our team on insurance audits like claims, pricing, and underwriting. You’ll collaborate with key stakeholders and audit colleagues to help us identify risks and shape solutions that continuously improve our control environment. Ultimately, your work will provide independent assurance to our audit committee, executive committee, and the wider business that we're managing our major risks effectively, helping us grow safely and boldly.
**What you will be doing: 🖋️**
* Assess the adequacy and operating effectiveness of the processes and controls in place for identifying, analysing and ensuring key risks are managed and are within Ki’s Risk Appetite (i.e. to examine, challenge, test and critique Ki’s Risk Management Process).
* Ensure that audits in the Annual Internal Audit Plan are delivered in accordance with the Internal Audit Procedures i.e. validating through independent review/audit of relevant documentation of the control framework including Policies, Protocols, Processes, Procedures, Information Security & Privacy Management Systems Frameworks, Underwriting Guidelines etc. and completing ad hoc assignments as required.
* Liaise with key stakeholders to plan and thereafter scope the assigned audits using the Ki Internal Audit Procedures.
* Produce planning documentation for all audits using templates in place and in agreed formats. This includes preparing a Risk and Control Matrix, for all audits and supporting working papers to produce a comprehensive audit file.
* Conduct audit fieldwork in line with Ki Internal Audit Procedures, which will include application of audit techniques such as interviews; meetings to evidence controls cited in the interviews or otherwise; detailed substantive work or controls testing (sample sizes to be determined by the Internal Audit Manager using Ki’s Internal Audit sampling methodology).
* Record the results of all testing to a clear, concise and “re-performable standard” in the Risk and Control Matrix. An independent reviewer of the audit should be able to understand what has been tested, why, how and when without a need to query the Internal Audit Manager; recognise audit evidence relied upon to reach a conclusion, as is clearly cited and reobtainable from the relevant business area. Lendable's Payments team transacts money for our UK Loans, AutoLend (motor finance) and Zable (credit card) products: disbursing loans, collecting repayments, refunding customers and reconciling everything against our banking providers.
We're bringing in a recent graduate on a 6-month contract to strengthen the controls around our daily loan funding and to add capacity across payments and partner indemnity recovery. A large part of our AutoLend lending is originated through third-party partners, and you'll own the daily process that verifies funds are flowing correctly through that chain before we release the next day's payments. You'll run that control every day, then use the remaining time to help us make it faster, better evidenced and, where possible, automated.

Daily funding controls (core responsibility)
* Run the daily pre-release checks on partner funding: gather payment evidence from our third-party partners, reconcile it to our disbursal records, and confirm that yesterday's funds reached the intended recipients before today's payments are approved.
* Hold, query or escalate anything that is missing, late or doesn't reconcile, and document the reason clearly so commercial, operations and risk colleagues can act on it.
* Keep a full audit trail of every check, exception and release decision so the control is evidenced for internal review and audit.
* Spot the trends in partner behaviour and payment timing that warrant a closer look, and raise them early.
* Run periodic verification of partner and payee bank details, and re-verify whenever a partner asks us to change where we pay them.
* Work with the Payments Manager to onboard more partners onto the control, and to turn the manual check into matching rules, scripts and monitoring that surface only the exceptions.
Payments and finance operations
* Support day-to-day payment operations: cash allocation of incoming repayments, refunds and returned payments, and reconciliation against our bank and payment providers.

* Prepare and reconcile the recovery figures that go to partners, track invoices raised against amounts received, and chase and resolve queries and shortfalls.
* Support the unwind process on cancelled agreements: making sure customer refunds, partner recoveries and internal ledger entries all tie back to the same numbers.

* Comfortable handling sensitive customer, partner and payment data responsibly.

**The AI Programme**This three-year programme is funded by the GLA aligning with their new ‘AI mission’ which has established an AI taskforce to look at the future of jobs and has goals such as providing ‘free AI skills training for Londoners’. This is a high profile and ambitious programme which will aim to support a high number of businesses, from different sizes and sectors. **Purpose of the role**
The AI Technology Adoption Specialist will support SMEs across London to transform their businesses through the integration of AI technologies and solutions to support business productivity - freeing up time to do other work, growth and competitiveness. Acting as the main point of contact for clients, the TAS will develop bespoke AI transformation roadmaps, provide specialist advice, and manage relationships with relevant SME sector networks to support engagement onto the programme.
The TAS will operate all across London to deliver workshops for SMEs supported through the programme, and will work from the L&P main office as well as remotely.

* Act as the primary contact for SMEs participating in the AI Integrate Accelerator programme.

This role will establish testing standards, plan and deliver resilience exercises, identify improvement opportunities, and drive remediation activities while ensuring compliance with DORA, Operational Resilience regulations, ISO 22301 standards, and emerging regulatory requirements (UK CTP).
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scenario Testing & Maturity**
* Own and enhance the D&A Scenario Testing strategy and roadmap.
* Lead the design and execution of severe-but-plausible resilience scenarios and testing exercises in alignment with LSEG frameworks and standards.
* Measure and report resilience maturity, testing outcomes, and improvement opportunities.
* Benchmark practices against regulatory expectations and industry standards.
**Regulatory Compliance & Governance**
* Act as the SME for resilience-related regulatory requirements including DORA, Operational Resilience, CTP, ICT Risk Management, and ISO 22301.
* Coordinate regulatory reviews, audits, assessments, and evidence gathering.
* Monitor regulatory changes and drive compliance remediation activities.
* Maintain relevant governance reporting and resilience documentation.
**Risk & Resilience Improvement**
* Identify resilience gaps, vulnerabilities, and recovery weaknesses through testing.
* Drive remediation initiatives with Technology, Product, Operations, Security, and Risk teams.
* Ensure testing outcomes translate into measurable resilience improvements.
**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with senior leaders across Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Security, Audit, and Business Continuity teams.
* Facilitate executive-level workshops and resilience exercises.
* Present outcomes, risks, and recommendations to governance and leadership forums.
**Qualifications & Experience**
**Essential**
* Extensive experience in Operational Resilience, Business Continuity, Technology Risk, or Regulatory Compliance.
* Proven experience leading scenario testing and resilience programmes.
* Strong understanding of DORA, Operational Resilience, ICT Risk, and Business Continuity frameworks.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and influencing skills.
* Experience managing regulatory audits, reviews, and remediation programmes.
**Preferred**
* Experience within Financial Services or other regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Critical Third Party (CTP) requirements.
* Professional certifications are beneficial.
**Success Measures**
* Successful delivery of the annual Scenario Testing Programme through all D&A IBS testing completion.
* Improved operational resilience maturity across D&A.
* Positive audit outcomes.
* Successfully achieved regulatory compliance including readiness for upcoming regulations.
* Timely remediation of identified resilience risks and issues.
* Demonstrable compliance with resilience and business continuity regulations.

Manager

Market Supervision forms part of the Market Regulation department which is responsible for regulating all the markets operated by LSE plc (the Recognised Investment Exchange). Market Supervision is responsible for monitoring secondary market trading on London Stock Exchange (“LSE”), Turquoise Global Holdings Limited (“TGHL”) and Turquoise Global Holdings Europe B.V (“TGHE”).
The purpose of Market Supervision is to ensure that trading is orderly and efficient, and in compliance with the Exchange’s rules (“the rules”) and to identify activity which may indicate market abuse as outlined in the UK Financial Conduct Authority’s Code of Market Conduct and MAR.
The role reports into the Head of Market Supervision.
**Purpose of the role**
This role will be responsible for co-leading and managing Market Supervision coverage for LSE’s 24x5 extended trading model, ensuring that trading remains orderly, efficient and compliant with the relevant trading venue rules during non-UK working hours.
Primary responsibilities include supervision of live market activity, management of trading halts, cancellations and disorderly trading events, interaction with member firms and internal stakeholders, investigation of unusual trading patterns, and development of procedures, playbooks and controls for LSE 24.
The role requires clear judgement, leadership capability and the ability to make well-documented decisions in time-critical situations
**Key responsibilities and accountabilities**
The role will include some or all of the following:
* Lead and manage real-time and post-trade supervision of LSE 24 activity ensuring effective oversight of trading behaviour, market quality, system events and participant activity.
* Act as a senior Market Supervision presence during non-UK working hours, providing experienced judgement and management of trading halts, trade cancellations, potential disorderly trading conditions and other market events.
* Drive the development, testing and continuous improvement of procedures, playbooks and escalation paths for overnight and cross-time-zone supervision.
* Provide senior input into surveillance coverage, controls calibration, market event handling and operational readiness for LSE 24
* Support readiness activity ahead of launch, including scenario testing, dress rehearsals, incident simulations, communication templates, regulatory evidence packs and lessons-learned processes.
* Interact with member firms and market participants on supervisory matters, including rule application, trade queries, incident follow-up and requests for information.
* Identify, investigate and escalate unusual trading patterns or potential market abuse indicators, including preparation of appropriate internal analysis and potential regulatory referral materials.
* Contribute to future expansion planning for LSE 24, including any broadening beyond the initial ETP scope, further operating model refinement, and potential interaction with future digital market infrastructure.
**Qualifications and experience**
**Essential**
* Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience in market supervision, trading venue operations, compliance, risk, front-office trading, surveillance, exchange operations or a similar regulated financial markets environment
* Strong understanding of secondary market trading, market structure, trading rules, order and trade lifecycle, and venue control frameworks
* Experience managing or escalating live market events, such as trading halts, disorderly trading conditions, trade cancellations, technical incidents or participant issues
* Strong working knowledge of applicable regulation relevant to UK and European trading venues, including MiFID, MiFIR and MAR
* Proven ability to lead teams, manage workflow and maintain effective decision-making in time-critical situations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to interact confidently with member firms, technology, operations, compliance, legal, risk and senior management.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce concise incident summaries, escalation notes, decision records and regulatory-ready explanations.
**Desirable**
* Experience supervising ETPs, RFQ models, quote-driven markets, bilateral settlement or extended-hours trading
* Familiarity with surveillance tools, trading platforms, incident management tools and large trading datasets
* Understanding of US and APAC market dynamics, including retail-driven flow, overnight liquidity conditions and out-of-hours market event risk
This role requires shift work to support overnight trading session, predominantly Asian hours 12:00-08:00

Manager

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
## **What we’re looking for**
* **7+ years running paid social**. You've owned significant budgets on Meta, and you've run or tested at least one other social channel, such as TikTok, Snap, Reddit.
* **Automation-led**. You don't do by hand what a script or an agent could do. You've built automations for reporting, budget pacing, or optimisation, and you're comfortable with platform APIs and pulling your own data.
* **Creative-obsessed**. On social, the creative does most of the targeting. You know what makes a thumb stop, you can brief and iterate with the creative team, and you keep a high-volume, diversified pipeline moving: UGC, creator content, static, video. You've taken a paid social channel from small to large and kept it efficient on the way up.
* **Efficiency-minded**. You think in CAC and payback, and you can tell efficient growth from spend that just looks like growth.
* **A disciplined tester**. You know how to stand up a new channel properly: clean test design, enough budget to read a result, and the judgement to call it quickly either way.
* **Hands-on by choice**. You'd rather be driving impact than in a deck. You like the detail, and you build things yourself.
* **Already building with AI.** You use AI day to day, you're comfortable building agents, and you'll use Lovable to ship the tools this role runs on.
* **Technical spike**. You go deep in at least one of: data analytics, data engineering, or tracking and measurement. You don't need all three at that level, but you need to be strong in one, comfortable in the rest, and delivering the work yourself.
## **What you’ll do**
* Run paid social end to end. Own Meta as a core channel. You set the account structure, the audiences, the bids, the budgets, and the targets, and you know when to lean on Advantage+ and when to take back control.

* Automate the day-to-day. Build agents and automations with Lovable that read performance, pace and shift budgets, flag issues like creative fatigue before they cost us, and make the changes. The goal is a paid program that mostly runs itself, with you steering.

* Stay in the details. You'll be in the accounts, running tests on audiences, placements, and creative, and building most of this yourself. This is a role for someone who wants their hands on the work.

We are looking to appoint a commercially minded and forward-looking Head of FP&A to own the Group’s end-to-end financial performance cycle, connecting monthly reporting and actual performance with forecasting, Budget, long-range planning and strategic scenarios business partnering. The role reports directly to the Group Commercial Finance Director.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
The Head of FP&A will be the senior integrator across actual performance, expected outturn and strategic outlook. The role will ensure that reported results are accurate and clearly explained, then use commercial MI and leading indicators provided through the Commercial Finance Lead to determine what performance means for the future, what choices are available and what action is required.
**Group reporting and performance narrative | 30%**
* Own the monthly Group reporting calendar, dependencies, submissions, reviews and sign-off process.
* Lead flash reporting, trading results, management reporting, Board performance materials and agreed investor-relations analysis.
* Create one consistent performance narrative across actuals, prior year, forecast, Budget, risks and opportunities.
* Coordinate and challenge Regional and Business Unit commentary.
* Ensure outputs across P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and working capital are reconciled, controlled, accurate and delivered to timetable.
* Ensure actual performance flows directly into expected outturn, forecast and management interventions.
* Lead automation and simplification of recurring Group reporting.
**Forecasting, Budget and LRP | 35%**
* Own the end-to-end Group forecast, Budget and long-range planning processes.
* Develop an independent Group outlook using client, pipeline, pricing, utilisation, capacity, margin, cash and other commercial drivers.
* Lead scenario and sensitivity analysis across revenue, cost, headcount, investment, working capital and cash.
* Own the Group risks and opportunities view.
* Lead Regional and BU forecast challenge, Group calibration, approval and lock.
* Drive forecast accuracy, planning discipline and accountability.
**Strategic performance and decision support | 20%**
* Translate financial and commercial information into implications, choices and recommendations for senior management.
* Lead strategic analysis supporting the CFO, Executive Leadership Team and Board.
* Assess how commercial drivers affect the Group outlook and recommend interventions.
* Develop forward-looking models supporting investment, cost transformation and resource allocation.
**Leadership, systems and operating model | 10%**
* Shape and embed the future FP&A operating model, governance, controls and decision rights.
* Lead, coach and develop the FP&A team.
* Act as business owner for Planful planning, forecasting, budgeting, workflow, controls and adoption.
* Set planning-system priorities and sponsor system development and rollout.
* Work with the Commercial Finance Lead to connect trusted commercial insight with stronger forward-looking decisions.
**OPERATING RHYTHMS AND KEY OUTPUTS**
**Monthly performance**
* Forums Led/Facilitated: Reporting readiness; Flash and Results Review; Group Performance Review; Board Pack Review; Reporting Sign-off.
* Key Outputs: Flash; management pack; Board pack; performance narrative; reconciled actuals.
**Monthly FP&A**
* Forums Led/Facilitated: Expected Outturn; Regional and BU Forecast Challenges; R&O Review; Group Calibration.
* Key Outputs: Integrated forecast; forecast bridge; R&O register; scenarios; actions.
**PBF cycle**
* Forums Led/Facilitated: PBF Kick-off; Central Shaping; submission reviews; Budget and LRP challenge; Executive and Board preparation; final lock.
* Key Outputs: Budget; LRP; assumptions; target-gap analysis; Board narrative; locked plan.
**Strategic**
* Forums Led/Facilitated: Strategic Outlook; Investment Case Review; Cost and Productivity Forum; Benefits Realisation Review.
* Key Outputs: Strategic scenarios; decision papers; investment cases; benefits tracker; interventions.
**ABOUT YOU**
You will be an experienced FP&A leader with strong commercial judgement, the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders and the ability to connect detailed performance with the wider strategic picture.
**Essential experience and qualifications**
* Professionally qualified accountant: ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent.
* Strong prior Technology, Media or Telecommunications experience.
* Substantial post-qualified FP&A and Commercial Finance experience.
* Proven ownership of Group reporting, forecasting, Budget and LRP in a multinational, multi-entity and multi-currency organisation.
* Strong CFO, executive and Board stakeholder experience.
* Demonstrable people-management and team-development experience.
* Experience managing central or corporate-function costs.
* Required experience of finance-system development, implementation or rollout.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain quality while working at pace.
**Desirable experience**
* Planful, Adaptive, Anaplan, OneStream or another PBF platform.
* Power BI or comparable BI tools.
* NetSuite or a comparable international ERP.
* Listed-company, investor-relations, agency or professional-services experience.
**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**
For the right candidate, we will offer a competitive salary and benefits package which includes 27 days annual holiday, private healthcare, employer contributory pension, life assurance and income protection. We also offer a host of benefits that support wellbeing including subsidised gym membership, whilst our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion sees us offer learning opportunities around D&I, mentoring programmes and the opportunity for all to participate in a number of active Employee Led Networks and associated events. London

Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants here.
\* As at 30 June 2026
**The Team**
Man Group’s business is powered by sophisticated technology with AI accelerating the next generation of transformation. Our technology stack is built on modern open-source components, both enabling day-to-day research and development, and supporting our 24hr trading. With adoption of AI-agents we are investing in security as a first-class concern. Man has a sophisticated AI platform – MAIA – that offers the best foundation models on our modern technology stack. As agents become more powerful, the security platform which supports safe agentic workflows is critical. This senior role will own the security architecture from end-to-end, setting the technical direction for the security platform. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction, make and document key design decisions and stay close to the engineering, building prototypes and reviewing code alongside the engineers who deliver it. **Role Responsibilities**
**Architecture and Direction** * Define and own the target security architecture (components, services and APIs) for internal applications and platforms, covering identity, authorisation and secrets.
* Set the Zero Trust roadmap: user and machine identity, just-in-time and least-privilege access, and policy enforcement at the point of use.
* Make and record architectural decisions, balancing risk, delivery speed and operating cost.
* Publish reference designs and paved-path patterns so that the default for teams is also the secure one.
**Engineering Leadership** * Lead the design of the security policy engine for scoped time-bound system and data access.
* Design and build the platform APIs that applications, AI agents and users call.
* Mentor engineers and lead design reviews.
**Collaboration** * Work with IAM, Infosec, Security Operations and Infrastructure teams so that controls can be monitored, detected and audited.
* Working with Developer, Infrastructure and AI platform teams to ensure solutions balance the security and agility requirements of Man.
* Explain risk clearly to engineers, senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders, and support audit and regulatory work.
**Key Competencies**
**Required** * Significant experience in security engineering or architecture, including end-to-end ownership of security architecture for production platforms.
* Strong Python skills; comfortable with Bash, SQL and log query languages.
* Policy-as-code (e.g., OPA/Rego, Kyverno, Cedar, OpenFGA, SPIFFE/SPIRE).
* Infrastructure-as-code and GitOps (Terraform, Ansible, Helm).
* Deep understanding of authentication, authorisation and secrets management (OIDC/OAuth, Azure AD/Entra ID, vault, Keycloak) and of access control models.
**Desirable** * Security of AI agents and LLM applications (delegated access, tool-use authorisation, prompt injection).

## Consultant in Respiratory Medicine
### NHS Medical & Dental: Consultant
### Job overview
The respiratory department operates a phased working job pattern. The appointee will be on ward duty (Respiratory Ward) for 1 week (7 days) at a time on a 1:5 rota. The respiratory consultants contribute equally to a 1:11 rota for respiratory in-reach to the AAU at HRI. 1 PA is allocated for respiratory inreach duties for week days. Respiratory Consultants are helped by a SpR as well and work can be distributed as per requirements. There will be consideration of time off in lieu (such as for weekend working). Six new patients per clinic will be booked as standard. At the start of the post we do not anticipate follow up patients to be booked in to clinic. ### Main duties of the job
The new appointee will be allocated a consultant colleague to mentor and support them when they start.

### Working for our organisation
The Humber Health Partnership is one of the largest acute and community Partnership arrangements in the NHS, seeing well over one million patients every year and managing a budget of over £1.3 billion.
Made up of two Trusts - Northern Lincolnshire and Goole NHS Foundation Trust (NLAG) and Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust (HUTH) - our Partnership has significant ambitions and is committed to delivering world-class hospital and community services for the 1.65 million people we serve.
Together we employ nearly 20,000 staff. Our five main hospital sites are Diana, Princess of Wales Hospital, Scunthorpe General Hospital and Goole and District Hospital, for NLAG and Hull Royal Infirmary and Castle Hill Hospital for HUTH.
As Teaching Hospitals working with the Hull York Medical School, we both lead and contribute to research in many areas - biomedical research, primary care, palliative medicine, cardiovascular and respiratory medicine, vascular surgery, cancer surgery and oncology.

job_description:
Fleet Management builds the automation layer for Meta's data center fleet. We own the systems that plan, orchestrate, and execute the operational workflows that keep hundreds of thousands of machines healthy, available, and efficient across every region, and increasingly across public cloud providers as well. Our platforms cover the full lifecycle of work performed on the fleet: - Planned maintenance and rollouts: firmware, kernel, OS, and hardware maintenance executed safely and predictably at fleet scale. - Unplanned work and repair: detecting failures, deciding what to do about them, and driving the repair workflow through until capacity returns to production. - Fleet lifecycle operations: turn-ups, decommissions, server and service moves, rack logistics, and capacity rebalancing. - Safety and capacity control: deciding how much of the fleet may be unavailable at once, resolving conflicts between competing operations, rate limiting, graceful cancellation, and emergency stop. - Autonomy: replacing human-driven operational decisions with automation and agentic workflows, backed by the observability and quality signals needed to trust them. The engineering problems are distributed systems problems - state machines, scheduling, conflict resolution, idempotency, partial failure, and strong safety guarantees over irreversible physical actions. Drive alignment across a wide cross-functional surface – capacity management, provisioning, remediation, hardware and data center operations, and external infrastructure providers. Much of the work is negotiating and formalising contracts and SLAs between systems and organisations
Change the operating trajectory. Replace escalation paths, one-off scripts and per-case integrations with platforms and abstractions; make structural reductions in operational load rather than incremental patches
Raise the engineering bar: mentor other engineers, set standards, and bring credible technical framing into roadmap and investment discussions

We are Studio La Plage, an award winning creative agency based in London working with some of the world’s best-known brands. From audience-first campaigns to brand storytelling, design, production, experiential and digital, our work is made by people who believe the details matter. Everything we create is strategically rigorous, creatively ambitious, and rooted in a deep understanding of the role brands play in the conversations that matter. We help brands simplify the complex, explore the biggest and most challenging issues, and forge deep connections with any audience, through human truth and creative mastery.
Craft earns attention. Intent creates connection.
As part of MHP Group, our work is shaped by deep sector expertise. Across consumers, financial services, technology and healthcare, we bring insight earned from years navigating complex, regulated and fast-moving environments. That perspective sharpens our intent and pushes our craft further, every time.
You’ll be given real responsibility from day one, alongside the support you need to develop your skills and the opportunity to help shape work that makes a genuine impact.
This is a hybrid role, with three non-set days each week in our London studio and the flexibility to work from home for the remaining two.
Role overview
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Designer who combines strong brand and visual communication skills with the ability to bring ideas to life through motion.
You’ll be a talented conceptual thinker, confident in developing new brands, evolving existing identities and creating distinctive brand worlds. Your work will be informed by a clear understanding of brands’ positioning, audience and culture.
Systems thinking is central to the role. You’ll create and develop coherent, flexible brand identities and visual systems that can be applied confidently across print, digital, social, presentations, campaigns, events and other communications. You’ll translate strategic ideas into beautifully crafted and engaging experiences, ensuring every expression feels consistent and connected.
Motion is an important part of the role. You’ll use animation and movement to bring brands, campaigns and digital experiences to life, from simple animated assets and social content to more considered motion systems for brand identities and interactive experiences.
You’ll develop concepts, present creative ideas internally and to clients, interpret briefs and use research and insight to inform your thinking. Working across print, campaigns, digital and motion, you’ll take projects from initial concept and ideation through to final artwork and delivery.
Projects will include developing brand identities and visual systems, creating campaign and communications assets, designing digital experiences and shaping identities for conferences, events and other branded experiences. You’ll work across a broad range of subjects, audiences and scales, collaborating with colleagues across strategy, creative, digital, production and teams across the wider MHP Group.
We’re looking for someone who is genuinely curious about complex subject matter and excited by the challenge of turning interesting, sometimes abstract ideas into clear and compelling visual communications.
You’ll be confident presenting and pitching your work, clearly articulating your creative thinking and design rationale, verbally, in writing and through the work itself. You’ll bring clients and colleagues along with your thinking, inspiring confidence through a combination of vision, craft and reliable delivery.
Who You Are:
You have 7+ years of design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating conceptual depth, strong brand thinking and work across a range of project types, formats and scales.
You have strong experience creating and developing brand identities, visual systems and communications.
You combine conceptual thinking with an exceptional level of design craft.
You can generate original concepts and creative ideas for print, digital, motion and multimedia projects.
You have strong motion design skills and experience using animation to bring brands, campaigns and digital experiences to life.
You understand how to develop motion principles and systems as part of a wider brand identity, rather than treating animation as a standalone output.
You have excellent visual judgement, with strong foundations in typography, layout, colour and image-making.
You’re passionate about visual storytelling and can communicate complex ideas in a clear, engaging and accessible way.
You can use Figma to develop wireframes, page structures and interactive prototypes, with an understanding of user journeys, accessibility and responsive design.
You’re confident presenting and pitching creative work, explaining your rationale and responding constructively to questions and feedback.
You can manage multiple projects at different stages, from initial brief and concept development through to final artwork and delivery.
You have solid production knowledge, including preparing work for print and handing digital designs over effectively to developers.
You’re highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and After Effects, as well as Figma, PowerPoint and Google Slides.
You’re proactive, curious and positive, with the confidence to work independently, solve problems and challenge thinking constructively.
You enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and contribute thoughtful, constructive creative feedback.
You’re approachable, inclusive and supportive of the wider team.
You have strong cultural awareness and remain curious about the world beyond design.
You maintain exceptional attention to detail and craftsmanship, ensuring every final output meets the highest creative and technical standards.
You stay informed about emerging technologies, tools and platforms relevant to branding, visual communication, motion and creativity.
Nice To Have:
Knowledge of UI and UX design.
An interest in AI-assisted creative workflows and emerging design and motion tools.

Overview
We are building and operating frontier-scale AI supercomputers used to train the world’s most advanced models. The backend network is a critical part of the machine: a single degraded NIC, switch, link, or path can reduce training performance or disrupt jobs spanning thousands of GPUs.
We are looking for a senior, hands-on Network Production Engineer to own the production health and operations of our multi-rail Ethernet backend network built on MRC and RDMA technologies. You will bridge network engineering, distributed systems, hardware health, and production operations to ensure the network delivers predictable performance at extreme scale.
Your mission is simple: make the network invisible to researchers by maximizing large-job success, minimizing performance degradation, and recovering quickly when failures occur.
Responsibilities
Own Production Network Health
Own the availability, performance, and operational readiness of the MRC Ethernet backend network.
Define and operate service-level indicators for packet loss, congestion, link health, path diversity, bandwidth, tail latency, collective performance, and job impact.
Detect slow or degraded components before they cause training failures or reduce model FLOPs utilization.
Build health models that correlate switch, NIC, host, topology, and application telemetry.
Operate the Network at Frontier Scale
Participate in on-call rotation and lead the response to high-severity network incidents.
Diagnose failures spanning GPUs, NICs, switches, cables, firmware, drivers, network operating systems, MRC, NCCL, Kubernetes, and training workloads.
Develop automated mitigation mechanisms, including path avoidance, node quarantine, workload relocation, and safe component remediation.
Create operational procedures for maintenance, upgrades, rollback, capacity expansion, and topology changes.
Improve Large-Job Reliability and Performance
Work directly with training teams to investigate collective-performance degradation, stalls, timeouts, job restarts, and unexplained MFU loss.
Translate low-level network signals into clear job-level impact.
Establish network qualification gates for admitting nodes and racks into large training pools.
Run failure-injection and resilience testing to validate behavior under link, NIC, switch, and path failures.
Improve placement and routing policies for jobs spanning racks, rows, and network planes.
Automate Fleet Operations
Build production-quality software and automation for network validation, monitoring, diagnosis, remediation, and fleet-wide change management.
Replace manual investigation with deterministic workflows and actionable alerts.
Automate firmware, driver, configuration, and network operating-system compliance checks.
Maintain authoritative network inventory, topology, and configuration state.
Reduce mean time to detect, isolate, mitigate, and permanently resolve failures.
Drive Cross-Company Execution
Lead technical investigations involving internal infrastructure teams, cloud and datacenter operators, Azure Networking, NVIDIA, switch and NIC teams, and network-software partners.
Own incidents through resolution, even when the underlying failure crosses organizational boundaries.
Produce clear root-cause analyses with corrective actions, owners, and completion dates.
Convert recurring production failures into requirements for future network, server, and accelerator architectures.
Create runbooks and train engineers across regions to provide reliable round-the-clock coverage.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline AND 4+ years technical experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering OR equivalent experience
Experience operating large-scale datacenter or high-performance computing networks in production environments.
Experience with Ethernet, RDMA, RoCEv2, congestion control, routing, load balancing, and lossless or near-lossless network design.
Experience diagnosing failures across switches, NICs, hosts, drivers, firmware, and distributed applications.
Experience working with Linux systems and programming in Python, Go, C++, or another systems-oriented programming language.
Experience building monitoring, automation, diagnostic, or remediation systems for production infrastructure.
Experience leading high-severity incident response and coordinating resolution across multiple engineering teams.
Experience analyzing telemetry to identify and validate root causes of infrastructure or network issues.
Ability to participate in a global on-call rotation.
Preferred Qualifications:

Experience operating GPU training clusters or other tightly coupled distributed-computing systems.
Knowledge of MRC or other multi-rail, multi-plane, multipath Ethernet transports.
Experience with NCCL, collective communications, CUDA, GPUDirect RDMA, and distributed training frameworks.
Familiarity with ConnectX-class NICs, modern Ethernet switch ASICs, SONiC, SAI, and switch telemetry.
Experience with InfiniBand and the operational differences between InfiniBand and Ethernet-based AI fabrics.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, Slurm, workload placement, and cluster-health certification.
Experience with streaming telemetry, gNMI, Prometheus, Datadog, Kusto, eBPF, or equivalent observability systems.

Moth is a quantum computing company pioneering the next era of media, entertainment and creativity.
We're looking for a Designer to shape how the company looks—across our website, brand, product interfaces, decks, socials and printed media. You'll work across identity, typography, layout, motion and image, and bring a consistent visual language to everything the company puts out, from Atlas (the Moth Platform) to a project microsite, to a conference stand.
Strong design instincts are required for this role, but we're also looking for a varied technical skillset: someone who moves quickly between different kinds of software and tools—a layout, a motion piece, a web page, a 3D render, a prototype, a generative system—and who can contribute to the in-house development of our creative applications. That means being eager to pick up new tools and skills, including code and quantum programming languages.
You don't need a quantum background, but you should be curious about it and able to make unfamiliar, complex ideas look clear. And you'll give the same care to a corporate deck as to an impact-driven, experimental project with the Studios team.
#### What you'll do
* Develop and maintain Moth's visual identity—typography, colour, layout, motion and image—and keep it consistent across everything the company puts out: website, product UI, launches, decks, social, events and print.
* Build out the design system as working tooling—Figma libraries and plugins, a Claude Design system—so it holds together across web and product and anyone on the team can produce on-brand work from it.
* Design interfaces for Atlas, our apps and demos, and work with engineering through to shipping—specs, components, review—so what goes out matches what was designed.
* Work with researchers to turn complex quantum concepts into interfaces, diagrams and explanations that non-specialists can follow.
* Collaborate with Studios and Marketing on launches, showcases, talks and partner projects.
* Build what you design where it makes sense: landing pages, microsites, components and prototypes in HTML, CSS and React.
#### What we're looking for
* A strong digital design portfolio: typography, layout, identity and image, with real work that has gone out into the world.
* 3–5+ years as a designer in a studio, agency or in-house team with a digital focus.
* Enough front-end to build your own work—HTML, CSS and some JavaScript or React—and the appetite to do more of it.

* Work in the open: you show things early, take the feedback, and iterate.
* Comfort working from a loose brief, making decisions and explaining them clearly to people who aren't designers.
* Based in London or willing to relocate, with a minimum of three days spent in the office each week.
#### What will set you apart
* Experience designing interfaces for software products, not only brand and campaign work.
* Creative coding or generative work—p5.js, three.js, shaders, TouchDesigner—or a personal site you built yourself that you're proud of.
* Motion and animation beyond a logo sting: interface motion, explainer animation, video editing.

* Experience in games, music or audiovisual culture.
* AI tools already in your workflow—image, video, code or agents—and a view on where they help and where they don’t.
* Exposure to quantum computing—or a genuine curiosity to learn what it is.
#### Why Moth
This is a chance to define how quantum-powered media looks and feels in practice. We are building at the edge of technology and culture, alongside engineers, researchers and creatives who care deeply about what they are building. The problems are ambitious. The standards are high. The thinking is rigorous.
You won't be refreshing an established brand. You will be defining what quantum computing looks like for a generation of people meeting it for the first time. How our core technologies look, feel and are understood will be shaped, in part, by you.
If you are energised by complexity, motivated by craft and excited by the idea of giving form to systems that do not yet exist, this is the place to do it.

A senior leadership role owning the strategy, reliability, and evolution of our entire Azure estate — infrastructure, networking, cloud security, budget management, and platform engineering. You'll report to the Director of Technology, manage a team of Cloud Engineers, and own the platform underpinning our consumer-facing products, data platform, and internal tooling. The automotive classifieds market has stagnated — prices keep rising, innovation has slowed, and the consumer experience hasn't evolved in over a decade. Dealers want alternatives and consumers deserve better.

# Solution Analyst (Loan Administration & Private Debt Servicing)
* Full-time
* Rank: Associate Director
* Employment Type: Permanent Full Time
## Company Description
MUFG Investor Services provides asset servicing solutions to the global investment management industry. Leveraging the financial and intellectual capital of MUFG – one of the largest banks in the world with $2.8 trillion in assets – we provide clients access to a range of leading solutions from fund administration, middle-office outsourcing, custody, foreign exchange, trustee services and depository to securities lending and other banking services.
With a diverse and dynamic network of offices across the globe, MUFG Investor Services provides challenging and rewarding careers. We achieve this by offering continuous learning and development, a collaborative team work environment, promotion of work-life integration, and exposure to a wide variety of work. Imagine your future at MUFG Investor Services where you can grow professionally, in a diverse and inclusive workplace that rewards your contribution.
#LI-Hybrid
## Job Description
The Solution Analyst owns the front-end analysis that turns an emerging business need into a clearly defined, well-understood piece of work, with the outcome, scope, and rationale established before delivery begins.
This is a Solution Analyst role within our loan administration and private debt servicing area. This is a business process outsourcing service: we service loans and private debt on behalf of clients, calculating and collecting borrower interest and allocating it to lenders, maintaining the loan records that downstream reporting and fund valuation depend on. The role brings deep loan-servicing and private-debt operational knowledge into the front-end of complex change. In some cases this servicing links into wider fund administration offerings we provide, and in others it stands alone.
The role sits within the Tech Solutions organisation as a deployable analytical and subject-matter-expert resource, not permanently embedded in any one team, and is deployed against the pipeline of complex work in this area.
**What you'll do**
* Act as the subject-matter expert and analytical lead for the platforms and processes that support our Private Debt offerings: loan administration, loan agency and CLO.
* Bring deep loan administration and servicing knowledge, covering the loan lifecycle from deal and position set-up through interest and fee calculation, drawdowns, repayments, and lender allocations, to the front-end shaping of solutions, so the work handed to delivery teams reflects how loan servicing actually operates and where it can be improved.
* Protect the integrity of the loan data that flows into downstream reporting and fund valuation, making sure that what the servicing platform produces is timely, accurate, and fit for the processes that depend on it.
* Conduct front-end analysis of complex work, covering feasibility, operating-model implications, data quality, and readiness, before a delivery team picks the work up.
* Collaborate across stakeholder groups to define and document business requirements, translating current-state analysis, requirements, and gaps into a clear solution intent.
* Go and get the information needed to do the analysis directly, querying data, reviewing system configuration and behaviour, and running analysis using AI tooling where it helps, rather than waiting for others to provide answers.
* Work alongside Solution Owners at the front-end of complex work to shape intent and acceptance criteria for the parts of the work that carry the most complexity.
* Represent technical limitations and implementation realities back to business stakeholders, and business intent back to engineers, translating in both directions.
* Identify risks a delivery team would not otherwise see, including data gaps, downstream impacts, operational-readiness concerns, and regulatory implications.
* Partner with Integration Quality Engineers on cross-team and cross-solution test scenarios that no single team can cover.
* Support adoption readiness where value realisation depends on more than the build, including communications, training, data clean-up, and operational change, particularly where readiness work spans teams.
* Recognise patterns across the business area, including recurring themes, overlaps, and opportunities for reuse, feeding roadmap shaping.
* Create and maintain supporting product documentation, including system overviews, functional narratives, and use cases.
## Qualifications
**Required**
* 8+ years of experience in loan administration, loan agency, or private debt / private credit servicing, ideally within a fund services, asset servicing, or agency-lending environment.
* Strong working knowledge of the syndicated and bilateral loan operating model: interest and fee accruals, coupon and amortisation schedules, drawdowns and repayments, PIK, unfunded commitments, and the pro-rata allocation of borrower interest to lenders.
* Demonstrable understanding of the loan life cycle end to end - from document interpretation and extraction of loan economics, through reporting build and integrations to downstream systems, all underpinned by reconciliations to safeguard data integrity.
* Substantial experience gathering, analysing, and documenting business requirements, and translating them into clear solution intent and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to model business processes and produce analytical artefacts such as process models, use cases, procedural guides, and scenarios.
* Strong analytical judgement, knowing what to look at, what to ignore, and when analysis is good enough to act on.
* Credibility with both business and technical stakeholders, with the ability to hold a view under questioning.
* Ability to host and drive requirements-gathering sessions using a variety of elicitation techniques (user story mapping, event storming etc).
* Experience or exposure to system integrations using APIs, S3, Snowflake and similar technologies.
* Expert proficiency in Excel and Word.
**Preferred**
* Hands-on experience with Sentry (Broadridge), is highly valued and will distinguish leading candidates. Experience in similar platforms would also be valuable (e.g. Allvue, Wall Street Office)
* Understanding of how loan servicing connects into fund accounting and NAV production, including exposure to a private markets accounting platform such as Investran, is a plus.
* Experience across multiple servicing locations or a distributed operating model.
* Experience using AI tools to accelerate the development of prototypes and proof-of-concepts (POCs).
* Experience of platform implementation, configuration, or migration projects.

Work with the acoustics team to develop new ideas and find novel ways to improve performance and sound quality.
Bring up the DSP and digital audio circuitry on prototype PCBs. Sometimes using oscilloscopes, logic analysers and audio test equipment.
Produce clear documentation to communicate your ideas and design decisions.
Engage in peer code review.

# Senior Technical Solutions Product Manager
London, England, United Kingdom
**Senior Technical Solutions Product Manager**

**Role overview**
Nasuni is looking for a **Senior Technical Solutions Product Manager** to own and evolve integrated enterprise solutions that bring Nasuni technology together with cloud platforms, security products, data services and technology partners.
This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who enjoys building systems, diagnosing difficult integration problems and turning multiple technologies into solutions that work reliably for customers.
You will work at the intersection of solutions architecture, technology alliances and product management. You will own assigned solution areas throughout their lifecycle: understanding customer requirements, designing architectures, building and validating environments, maintaining technical relationships with technology partners and translating what you learn into product and integration improvements.
This is **not a traditional feature Product Manager role and not a purely advisory architecture position**. You should be comfortable opening a lab environment and building the solution yourself.
**Level & scope**
You will independently own technically complex solution and integration areas involving Nasuni products and third-party technologies. You will make day-to-day architecture, validation and solution-readiness recommendations while partnering with Product and Engineering on decisions requiring broader product investment.
Success requires approximately equal comfort working with infrastructure and working with people: customers, engineering teams, support, field technical teams and external technology partners.
**What you'll do**
* Design, build and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning Nasuni, third-party platforms, public cloud and customer infrastructure.
* Independently create lab and reference environments involving identity services, networking, security, virtualisation, compute and storage across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Own the technical relationship for assigned technology-alliance partners, maintaining regular engineering and roadmap alignment as products on both sides evolve.
* Diagnose complex integration and escalated customer issues, reproduce problems in lab environments and work with internal teams and partners through resolution.
* Validate compatibility and solution readiness through proofs of concept, release testing and reference deployments.
* Translate customer and partner feedback into clear integration requirements, technical recommendations and product-roadmap input.
* Evaluate potential technology partners and alternative solutions when customer needs or market developments expose integration gaps.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, deployment guidance and technical documentation that improve consistency for customers, Support and field teams.
* Stay current across enterprise file and object storage, hybrid cloud, security, data governance and emerging AI infrastructure use cases.
* Use AI-assisted research, analysis, troubleshooting and documentation workflows where they improve speed or insight, while validating technical outputs and protecting sensitive information.
**Expected outcomes and impact**
* Integrated solutions remain reliable as Nasuni and partner technologies evolve.
* Complex technical issues are reproduced and resolved more quickly.
* Integration gaps reach Product and Engineering with clear technical evidence.
* Field and Support teams receive validated, repeatable solution patterns.
* Technology-partner relationships produce stronger customer experiences rather than disconnected products.
* New solution opportunities are identified from customer, partner and infrastructure-market signals.
**Qualifications**
**Must-have**
* 6 to 10+ years of relevant experience in solutions architecture, systems/infrastructure engineering, solutions engineering, technical product work or a closely related discipline.
* Strong hands-on experience building and troubleshooting enterprise infrastructure rather than only designing or overseeing it.
* Working knowledge of enterprise file/storage technologies and protocols such as SMB/NFS plus modern object/API-based approaches such as S3 or REST.
* Practical experience with cloud infrastructure in AWS, Azure and/or GCP and with hybrid on-premises/cloud environments.
* Experience integrating multiple vendor technologies into an end-to-end solution.
* Strong grounding in networking, identity, security and virtualised infrastructure.
* Experience diagnosing difficult technical issues across multiple components or organisational boundaries.
* Ability to communicate architecture and trade-offs clearly to engineers, partners, customers and non-specialist stakeholders.
* Has personally built full enterprise test environments from identity and networking through compute, storage, security and cloud connectivity.
* Has owned both the architecture and ongoing health of a third-party integration.
* Has experience moving between legacy NAS environments and modern cloud/object/data-platform architectures.
* Understands emerging AI infrastructure and unstructured-data use cases and can connect them to practical enterprise architecture decisions.
**Preferred**
* Experience in enterprise storage, file data, data infrastructure, data protection, data security or infrastructure software.
* Experience creating PoCs, reference architectures or deployment blueprints.
* Experience maintaining technical relationships with ISVs or technology-alliance partners, from a technical level.
* Experience with enterprise security, governance or data-security platforms.
* Exposure to CI/CD, infrastructure automation or API-driven deployment.
**Experience guidelines**
Typical profiles may bring **6–10 years of relevant technical experience**, including meaningful depth in infrastructure, cloud, storage or integrated enterprise solutions. Direct Product Management experience is useful but is not required; demonstrable technical ownership matters more than title history.
**About Nasuni**
Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organisations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics and global collaboration.

From the UK, you'll collaborate with technology partners, customers and Nasuni teams across Europe, North America and India, giving this role a natural position at the centre of a global technical ecosystem. Nuclear fission is key to deploying reliable low-carbon power at scale and in the UK as the percentage of electricity generated by nuclear power increases, the need to ensure a secure supply of fuel for our reactor fleet will become even more pertinent. Nearly all the UK’s historic and existing nuclear reactors have been fuelled using a UK-led supply chain for uranium enrichment and fuel fabrication. The Springfields Fuels Limited (SFL) site, based near Preston and now part of the Westinghouse Electric Company (WEC), has hosted fuel fabrication facilities for over 80 years and has manufactured nuclear fuel for both UK reactors and internationally. The UK’s current nuclear reactor fleet utilises uranium-based fuels which are enriched to up to 5 w/o 235U, the fissile isotope of uranium, and SFL has supplied a variety of fuels, including for the former MAGNOX fleet, as well as the current Advanced Gas-cooled Reactors (AGRs). Next generation nuclear reactors have different characteristics to reactors currently in operation and will require fuels of a higher enrichment level, up to 19.75 w/o 235U (uranium enriched to between 5 – 20 w/o 235U is termed High-Assay Low Enriched Uranium or HALEU), which will require new front-end fuel cycle facilities to be established within the UK.
UKNNL are supporting the development of capability for the deconversion of uranium hexafluoride (UF6) to uranium oxide (e.g. triuranium octaoxide, U3O8) at capacities relevant to HALEU and research and development into alternative deconversion technologies, as well into the fabrication of advanced fuels for next generation reactors, such as coated particle fuels and high-density fuels.
It is essential that accumulated skills are maintained and enhanced, whilst undertaking world leading, cutting-edge research, as both are crucial for the successful delivery of sustained and new nuclear generation. This bursary scheme, hosted by UKNNL in collaboration with Westinghouse, aims to enable and encourage students to work on topics of national priority relating to uranium based nuclear fuels and supporting front end fuel cycle activities with a focus on:
* Conversion
* Deconversion
* Enrichment
* Advanced fuel fabrication
* Transport (of HALEU)
* Supporting functions: Criticality, Security & safeguards, environmental, engineering design, process monitoring, chemical & process modelling
* Waste treatment
It is not a requirement for practical-based projects to involve the use of uranic materials and projects utilising appropriate surrogates, where applicable, will also be accepted.

* The maximum value of the bursary is £6,500.
* The bursary may be held alongside other scholarships, studentships, awards or bursaries.
* The bursary shall be awarded on the basis of financial need, compatibility with the aims and scope of the HALEU Programme and on recommendation of the panel.
* Applications from under-represented groups are encouraged and supported.
* Applicants must be willing and able of undergoing national security vetting at the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) level.
**Essential Criteria:**
* Students must be on accredited courses with in-scope nuclear science or engineering content:
+ Full or part-time integrated undergraduate master’s courses wherein the student will be entering their final year of study (either on a taught programme or year in industry) in the 2026/2027 academic year.
+ Full or part-time post-graduate master’s degrees courses with modules at master’s degree level being taken with examination on a post-graduate certificate, post-graduate diploma or part/full-time MSc/MRes (or equivalent).

Welcome to NewGen
We're a global social and creator agency that exists to make brands iconic, standing at the forefront of culture, creators and community.
Founded by our 30 under 30 co founders, NewGen is an independent agency working with some of the world's biggest brands including Pepsi, Samsung, Amazon, SEGA and Cash App.

The Role
We're looking for a Head of Clipping to join our growing team and build and run our clipping programme from the ground up. You'll own the proposition, the clipper network, the tech that runs it, and the results we deliver for clients, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with our commercial, creator and tech teams.
Clipping is one of the fastest-growing parts of what we do: turning long-form moments, streams, trailers and creator activations into short-form content that travels across TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, X and whatever comes next. This role exists because we want to lead the category, not follow it.
What you'll do
* Build and own the clipping proposition: define how we sell clipping across our three models (repurposing long-form for brand channels, distribution at scale through clip pages and networks, and clippable moments within wider creator campaigns); own the commercial model, including CPM pricing, view caps, geo targeting and margin; and partner with account teams on pitches, proposals and client workshops as our clipping expert
* Run the programme end to end: plan, launch, run and report on clipping campaigns across gaming, entertainment, sport and consumer brands; set the quality bar for clips, hooks, captions and formats; and deliver reporting that proves reach, audience quality and outcomes, not just view counts
* Grow and manage the clipper network: recruit, vet and onboard clippers through Clipfarm, Discord communities and direct outreach; manage the full clipper workflow (sign-up, audience verification, channel authentication, view caps and payouts); and build relationships with the best clippers and clip pages so we get first call on the strongest talent
* Own the clipping tech: act as product owner for our clipping tooling and its fit within NewGen Multiple, our campaign management and reporting platform; use it daily to run campaigns at scale; and automate the repetitive parts so the team can focus on strategy and quality
* Keep NewGen and our clients at the front of the category: track platform changes, new formats and new monetisation routes, turn them into opportunities for clients, and share insight internally so the wider agency can sell and deliver clipping with confidence
* Build a team: over time, hire and lead a small team of clipping specialists and campaign managers
Office location & Days

What You'll Bring
* Hands-on experience running clipping or short-form distribution programmes, at an agency, a platform, a creator business, or as an operator in the clipping ecosystem
* An insider's knowledge of the clipper world: how clippers find campaigns, how they get paid, what makes them pick one brief over another, and where the quality and fraud risks sit
* A deep feel for what performs on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X: hooks, pacing, captions, trends and platform quirks
* Comfort with numbers: CPMs, view caps, margin, reach quality and reporting that stands up to client scrutiny
* Experience working with tech or product teams, or building your own tooling, to run campaigns at scale
* The ability to build something from nothing: you set the process, write the playbook, hire the people and fix what breaks
* Confidence in front of clients, and the ability to explain clipping to a CMO and a Discord mod in the same afternoon
* An eye for gaming, entertainment and creator culture, and a genuine interest in where short-form content is heading
Nice to have

* Experience briefing creators or editors and managing an editing pipeline

* Experience hiring and managing a small team

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Technical Account Management, Support and Services (TAMSS) supports Stripe’s largest, fastest-growing, and most strategically important users through our paid support offerings.
Technical Account Managers serve as trusted advisers to users and account teams. They combine an understanding of a user’s business, Stripe integration, technical architecture, and strategic priorities to improve integration performance and resilience, lead complex engagements, and coordinate Stripe’s response to critical issues.
The EMEA organization supports direct merchants and platforms across a diverse set of markets, industries, and technical environments. The team partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Solutions Architecture.
