job_description:
## Role purpose
The Head of AI and Technology is accountable for the direction, delivery and adoption of AI across Teneo Management Consulting and for ensuring that its broader technology environment supports the needs of the business. The role sets the AI strategy and investment priorities, leads the AI Engineering team, owns the strategy and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data, knowledge-management workflows and subscriptions, and acts as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT on centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.
The role connects Management Consulting's priorities with Teneo's central AI team, Teneo IT and other control and enabling functions. It translates business needs into Management Consulting-owned AI and technology initiatives or clear requirements for central teams, moves high-value AI and software solutions from experimentation into reliable use, and gives consultants the skills and support required to use approved AI tools effectively.
It is primarily an internal capability role. The role is accountable for the allocation and utilisation of the AI Engineering team, including support for selected client engagements, and for the Management Consulting-specific AI and broader technology within its remit. Teneo IT and Teneo's central AI team remain accountable for the centrally managed services and capabilities, while Management Consulting engagement leaders retain accountability for client relationships, overall engagement delivery and revenue targets.
## Key responsibilities
### AI strategy and priorities
* Own the Management Consulting AI strategy, roadmap and priorities, aligned with the business strategy and Teneo-wide AI direction. Consult Teneo's central AI team on new solutions to reuse firm-wide capabilities, avoid duplication and manage enterprise dependencies.
* Identify and assess AI opportunities across consulting delivery, business development, proposition development, internal operations and knowledge work.
* Own prioritisation of AI opportunities and allocation of AI Engineering capacity within the approved budget, considering value, feasibility, risk, reuse potential, capacity and cost. Escalate material investments, major reprioritisation and strategically sensitive work to Management Consulting leadership.
* Develop business cases and recommend whether Management Consulting should build, buy, partner, reuse a central capability, scale an existing initiative or stop further investment.
* Define outcome measures for priority AI initiatives and report progress, realised value, adoption, spend, risks and dependencies to Management Consulting and wider Teneo leadership.
### Leadership of the AI Engineering team
* Lead the day-to-day work of the Management Consulting AI Engineering team, including objectives, prioritisation, resource allocation, workforce planning, utilisation, delivery oversight and performance management.
* Balance the team's capacity across client engagements, internal tooling development, enablement of the broader MC team, and technical capability improvement, while maintaining sustainable workloads.
* Set and enforce engineering and product standards for Management Consulting AI solutions, consistent with mandatory Teneo-wide architecture, AI, security and technology standards.
* Define clear demand, resourcing and decision-making processes between the AI Engineering team and key stakeholders, including Resourcing, Operations, Finance, project leads and the wider client-facing team.
* Build the team's capability through recruitment, coaching, feedback, career development and targeted use of external partners where justified.
* Maintain high practical AI fluency and sufficient technical understanding to create simple prototypes, automations and demonstrations, evaluate their outputs and translate business needs into clear engineering requirements, without becoming the bottleneck for implementation.
### AI service lifecycle
* Oversee the path from discovery and prototyping to production, adoption, support and retirement for Management Consulting AI solutions.
* Ensure solutions are designed for reuse where appropriate and integrate with approved data, identity, security and collaboration environments.
* Establish proportionate evaluation and monitoring for quality, reliability, user experience, cost and risk, including controls for generative AI outputs.
* Define ownership and support arrangements before launch, and ensure that technical debt, maintenance and business continuity inform investment and prioritisation decisions.
### Business partnership and consulting integration
* Partner with Management Consulting leadership and practice leads to translate business priorities into a focused AI agenda and secure decisions on investment, risk and operating change.
* Support proposition and methodology development by identifying where approved AI capabilities can improve the quality, speed or differentiation of consulting work.
* Advise case teams on feasible and responsible use of AI, deploying the AI Engineering team where specialist support is justified. Own the team's allocation and utilisation; engagement leaders remain accountable for client relationships and engagement delivery.
* Represent Management Consulting in relevant Teneo forums and maintain productive relationships with external technology and delivery partners.
### Teneo IT partnership and centrally managed technology
* Act as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT, representing the business's needs and priorities in relation to centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.
* Translate Management Consulting requirements into clear input for firm-wide technology strategy, roadmaps and investment decisions, and communicate central plans, constraints and decisions to Management Consulting leadership.
* Coordinate with Teneo IT and relevant central functions on architecture, integration, identity and access, hosting, resilience, service support and technology changes affecting Management Consulting.
* Monitor the performance of centrally managed services within Management Consulting, escalating material issues and working with Teneo IT to agree appropriate action.
### Management Consulting technology, knowledge management and subscriptions
* Own the strategy, roadmap and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data and subscriptions, aligned with business and AI priorities and Teneo-wide standards.
* Maintain a coherent view of Management Consulting applications, data sources, knowledge assets, licences and subscriptions, reducing duplication and addressing material capability gaps.
* Own selected technology-enabled knowledge-management workflows, including the capture, organisation, permissioning, retrieval and reuse of knowledge for consulting and AI-enabled workflows.
* Work with client-facing teams and designated knowledge owners to establish clear accountability for the quality, permissions and appropriate use of knowledge assets, while acting as a key stakeholder in wider knowledge-management decisions.
* Lead business cases, supplier evaluation, procurement and renewals for Management Consulting-specific tools and services. Manage approved expenditure, licences and consumption within delegated authority and the relevant central approval processes.
### Training enablement and adoption
* Set the AI capability-building plan for Management Consulting, based on the needs of different roles, practices and levels of experience.
* Direct practical training, guidance, demonstrations, office hours and communities of practice that help colleagues apply approved tools to real consulting workflows.
* Expand the network of leaders and super-users who can reinforce good practice, surface demand and support adoption within their teams.
* Measure confidence, active use, quality and workflow impact, and adapt the enablement programme where training does not translate into sustained behaviour change.
* Maintain clear communication on available tools, expected use, limitations, new releases and routes for support.
### Responsible AI governance and risk
* Consult Teneo's central AI team on proposed solutions to identify existing capabilities, avoid duplication and maintain alignment with Teneo-wide AI direction.
* Work with Cyber Security, Risk, Legal and IT to translate firm-wide requirements into practical delivery and usage controls.
* Ensure new AI solutions receive the required Cyber Security and Risk approvals prior to implementation, with clear records of decisions, exceptions and accountable owners.
* Promote safe handling of client and firm information and address emerging model, vendor and regulatory risks as the technology changes.
## Experience and capabilities
* Substantial experience setting and delivering an AI and technology strategy in a professional services, consulting or similarly knowledge-intensive environment.
* Demonstrable experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and taking AI or software products from discovery into secure, supported production use, with the judgement to challenge decisions on architecture, integration, evaluation, security and operational support.
* High practical AI fluency, demonstrated through regular use of generative AI tools and the ability to create and evaluate simple prototypes, automations or workflows. Production coding experience is not required, but the candidate must recognise when specialist engineering support is needed.
* Evidence of converting ambiguous business needs into prioritised initiatives, investment cases, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.
* Experience of technology and data governance, including responsible AI, information security, privacy, vendor risk and approval processes.
* Experience improving data or knowledge-management workflows in a professional services or similarly knowledge-intensive environment, particularly where these support enterprise search, knowledge retrieval or AI-enabled use.
* Commercial judgement in build-versus-buy decisions, vendor selection, budgets, licences, subscriptions and consumption management.
* Experience designing enablement or change programmes that produce sustained adoption, rather than training attendance alone.
* Experience representing a business unit in relation to centrally managed technology services, translating requirements, explaining technical choices clearly and influencing enterprise technology priorities.
* Strong people leader: sets direction, develops talent, gives clear feedback and builds effective teams.

# New Trustees
The Chancery Lane Project (TCLP) is looking to appoint up to three new trustees to strengthen our Board in two areas that are important to our future: (i) the legal sector and the future of legal practice, and (ii) fundraising, philanthropy and strategic relationships.
As we work to make climate-aligned contracting standard commercial practice, we need a Board that understands not only how the legal sector works today, but how legal practice is developing and what that could mean for how TCLP creates impact in the future. We also want to strengthen the Board’s experience of the funding landscape and its ability to support TCLP in building the relationships and networks that will underpin our long-term sustainability and impact.
### **Who are we?**
TCLP is an independent charity and specialist legal knowledge organisation using contracts to drive positive outcomes for climate, nature and society.
Since 2019, we have helped prove that climate-aligned contracting works, pioneering practical legal tools that turn climate commitments into action. Our focus now is on making climate-aligned contracting standard commercial practice by making our specialist legal knowledge easier to access, apply and integrate wherever legal work happens.
As our work broadens across climate, nature and social outcomes, our ambition is to turn what we have learned into lasting, systemic change.
### **The specialist experience we are looking for**
We are looking to appoint up to three trustees who can strengthen the Board in two priority areas:
#### **Legal sector and the future of legal practice – two trustees**
We are looking for two senior legal professionals who can bring strong experience from different parts of the legal sector and help TCLP understand how the legal ecosystem is developing and what this could mean for our route to impact.
We welcome applications from people with significant experience in any part of the legal ecosystem, including private practice, in-house legal teams, legal operations, knowledge, legal technology or other areas of legal practice. You do not need experience across all of these areas. We are looking for depth in your own field and the perspective you can bring from it.
We are particularly interested in people who understand how legal work is done in practice and how developments such as AI are changing legal services, professional workflows, business models and the way legal knowledge is accessed and applied. You do not need to be an AI or legal technology specialist, but should be able to bring sound judgement about the opportunities and challenges these developments create for TCLP.
We will consider the balance of experience and perspectives across the two appointments when making our final selection.
#### **Fundraising, philanthropy and strategic relationships – one trustee**
We are looking for someone with significant experience of fundraising or philanthropy and a strong understanding of the funding landscape. You might bring experience as a funder, philanthropist, senior fundraising leader or through another role involving funding strategy and relationships.
We are looking for someone who can bring strategic insight, challenge and relevant networks, rather than take responsibility for delivering TCLP’s fundraising.
#### **Across all three appointments**
We want our new trustees to broaden the Board’s collective perspective as well as strengthen these areas of expertise. We will consider the overall balance and diversity of the Board, including the different professional backgrounds, perspectives, experiences and communities our trustees bring.
We do not expect individual candidates to bring everything described above. We are interested in the experience and perspective each person would add to the Board as a whole.
### **About being a TCLP trustee**
TCLP’s trustees provide strategic oversight, constructive challenge and good governance, working with the Executive Director and team to ensure the organisation remains financially sustainable, mission-focused and positioned to maximise its impact.
**Location:** Mostly remote, with up to two in-person sessions in London each year.
**Term:** Trustees are appointed for an initial three-year term and serve on a voluntary basis.
**Time commitment:** Approximately 6-8 days per year, including preparation for:
* five 1.5-hour Board meetings, usually held in February, April, June, October and November; and
* up to two full-day strategy sessions, usually held in central London.
Some additional time may occasionally be needed for strategic discussions, recruitment or representing TCLP externally. Reasonable UK travel and subsistence expenses for in-person sessions are covered.
### **What we expect from all trustees**
All trustees share responsibility for TCLP’s governance and strategic direction. We are looking for people who think strategically, bring sound judgement and curiosity, and can provide constructive support and challenge while navigating complexity and change.
### **Find out more about TCLP**
* Read our **Introduction to TCLP** for an overview of our work, strategic direction and approach to impact.
* Take a look at our **website** and **2025 Impact Report**.
### **Ready to join us?**
If you are excited by the opportunity to help shape an organisation that is rethinking how law can deliver planet positive impacts, we’d love to hear from you. This is a chance to work alongside an ambitious Board and the Executive Director and Chief Operating Officer to help ensure that climate and nature-positive contracting becomes part of everyday legal practice around the world.
For an informal conversation please contact the People Manager at zita.stewart@chancerylaneproject.org.
**How to apply**
Please send your CV together with a brief supporting statement (no more than one page) describing what attracts you to joining the Board and how your skills, experience and networks would strengthen the Board.
**The deadline for applications is 30 October 2026.**
Contact zita.stewart@chancerylaneproject.org for further details or to apply

Belfast, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom
**Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.**
Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?
At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.
Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.
**About TRG Screen**
TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.
TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.
**Position: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack**
**Location: Belfast**
**Team: Optimise Spend**
**The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Java) to join TRG Screen’s engineering team. You will design, develop, and evolve backend services and frontend applications across our enterprise product suite — a hands-on role that blends new feature development with improving and modernising complex, established codebases. TRG Screen is an AI-driven engineering organisation; this role is expected to use AI tooling by default across the full development lifecycle.
**Responsibilities**
**Development & Delivery**
* Design, develop, and maintain backend systems and frontend applications, including modernisation of complex, established codebases.
* Participate in the full SDLC — requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release support.
* Operate independently on complex tasks, owning features end-to-end from design through to deployment.
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to clean code principles.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues, including performance and scalability challenges.
* Use AI tooling as standard practice across design, implementation, code review, and testing to improve quality and delivery speed.
**Technical Leadership**
* Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decision-making.
* Apply clean code principles and design patterns to deliver maintainable, scalable systems.
* Champion automated testing practices and contribute to system reliability, performance, and security.
* Actively adopt AI-driven development practices and contribute to their adoption within the team.
* Produce technical documentation including design specifications and runbooks.
**Team Leadership & Collaboration**
* Collaborate effectively with product managers, QA, UX designers, and other stakeholders.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to team knowledge through pairing and documentation.
* Communicate clearly on technical topics with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and continuous process improvement.
**Required Skills and Qualifications**
* Strong Java experience (5+ years) in enterprise or large-scale backend systems
* Experience working with complex, established codebases.
* Knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience in modern front-end frameworks (Angular, React, or similar).
* Knowledge of relational databases and ORM frameworks.
* Solid understanding of clean code principles, design patterns, and testing practices.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams.
**Preferred**
* Exposure to microservices architecture and API design.
* Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience using AI-driven development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to enhance productivity and code quality.
* Familiarity with spec-driven development — using structured specifications to guide AI coding agents and validate generated output (e.g., BMAD, GitHub Spec-Kit).
* Familiarity with financial services or research technology domains.

# Senior Software Engineer - Cloud/SRE (Full-Stack) - Fully Remote (UK/ EU)
## Join TryHackMe as a Senior Cloud/Software Engineer to help millions learn cyber security. Build scalable, secure apps with TypeScript, React and Node.js in a remote, collaborative, impact-driven team.
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
**Keep a platform serving 8 million+ learners fast, reliable and cost-efficient and help decide how it should be built.**
Join TryHackMe as a Senior Cloud/Software Engineer. This isn't a traditional DevOps role. It's for a strong software engineer who has gone deep into cloud infrastructure, reliability and distributed systems. You'll work across AWS and Vercel on infrastructure shaped by unusually demanding cyber security learning environments.
**Location/Time zone:** this is a remote role, but strong overlap with UK business hours is required.
### The Role
TryHackMe operates across AWS and Vercel, supporting live virtual machines, hands-on security exercises and a high-traffic web product. You'll work in a small, focused **Cloud/SRE squad** with real ownership over how the platform evolves.
We're looking for a senior software engineer with strong hands-on AWS and infrastructure experience who can own problems across application code, cloud infrastructure, reliability, security and cost. You should be as comfortable changing production TypeScript/Node.js as you are debugging a distributed system or evolving its infrastructure.
This is not a traditional DevOps role focused on pipelines or infrastructure in isolation. We need someone who owns the whole problem, including existing systems, and can make pragmatic decisions about how they should evolve.
You'll be working on things like:
* Designing and operating software, tooling and AWS infrastructure across networking, compute, containers, databases, IAM, storage and security
* Writing and maintaining production Node.js/TypeScript alongside infrastructure-as-code and automation
* Cloud cost optimisation and finding more efficient ways to run the platform without compromising reliability
* Reliability, observability, incident response, disaster recovery and failure testing
* Operating and scaling production databases, including performance, capacity and availability concerns
* Vercel and our evolving application hosting model
* Developer tooling and automation that reduce operational overhead
* Working with Content Engineering on the virtual-machine infrastructure powering our hands-on learning experience
* Supporting security and assurance work, including technical controls and audit findings
Day to day, you'll own technical problems from discovery through production, debug across software and infrastructure, lead code and design reviews, mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team.
### What You'll Bring
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping and owning production software
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, beyond basic service familiarity or certification-level knowledge
* Solid infrastructure depth across networking, compute, containers, serverless, IAM, storage, monitoring and security
* Strong production debugging skills and a good understanding of distributed systems
* Experience operating and scaling production databases
* Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation experience
* Good judgement around reliability, performance, security, cost and long-term maintainability
* Confidence with AI development tools such as Cursor, Codex or Claude, paired with the judgement to challenge their output
* Clear communication and the ability to work effectively in a small, high-ownership team
* Able to work with strong overlap with UK business hours
* Bonus: NoSQL/MongoDB experience, Vercel, Next.js infrastructure, Kubernetes/ECS, observability, high-scale SaaS, disaster recovery or chaos engineering.
### Why This Role
Our infrastructure problems aren't generic. They're genuinely unusual, and you'll have real influence over how we solve them, not just a rulebook to follow.

* 🚣 100% Remote - work from anywhere you want!
* 💻 Tools - a dedicated work laptop + any accessories you need to do your best work.
* 👕 Swag Pack - start your TryHackMe journey with a branded swag bundle!
* 💪 Personal Development - £2,500 training budget to acquire certifications, and more.
* ⛱️ Company Retreat - an annual company retreat, fully paid for us!
* 🍕 Lunch on us - covered during our recurring company virtual lunches.
* 🧡 Health Insurance - if you're in a country that doesn't have public health care.
* 🍼 Enhanced Maternity & Paternity - an enhanced package on top of statutory requirements.
* 💸 401k / Pension - TryHackMe makes it easy to save money for your retirement.

# Marketing Analyst (Early Careers Programme 2027)
London, England, United Kingdom
|
Team: **M&C Analysts**
Apply now
**Start your career solving some of the biggest questions in sport and entertainment!**
We are Two Circles, a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business that grows audiences and revenues by understanding fans better than anyone else.
We help the world's leading sports and entertainment organisations answer the questions that drive their growth. Who are their fans – and what makes them tick? How can they reach new audiences? What makes someone buy a ticket, subscribe, engage with content or choose one brand over another? Where is the next commercial opportunity – and what does the data tell us to do about it?
We combine data, technology and commercial thinking to find the answers and turn them into action. Today, more than 1,000 organisations globally trust our platforms and services, including the Premier League, UEFA, the NFL, Red Bull, Visa, Nike and Amazon. We're a team of more than 1,000 people across 15 offices, working with sports and entertainment businesses of every shape and size around the world. **Our Early Careers Programme**Our Early Careers programme is designed for bright, curious people who want to solve interesting problems and make an impact from the beginning of their careers.
As an Analyst, you'll work at the intersection of data, marketing and commercial strategy. One project might see you digging into millions of fan interactions to uncover an opportunity for growth. Another could have you helping plan and optimise a digital campaign across Meta, Google or TikTok. On another, you might be researching the market for potential brand partners and helping shape a sponsorship proposition for a major sports property.
What connects the work is a simple idea: understand fans, find the opportunity, and work out what to do next.
You'll learn to work with data, structure ambiguous problems, communicate your thinking and turn analysis into recommendations that clients can act on. You'll work alongside talented people from different disciplines, take on real responsibility and develop skills that will form the foundations of a career in consulting, marketing and the business of sport and entertainment.
You don't need to arrive with all of those skills. We're looking for the potential to develop them: intellectual curiosity, an appetite for solving problems, comfort with numbers, and the ability to work brilliantly with other people.
If you're fascinated by what makes fans tick, excited by the commercial possibilities of sport and entertainment, and looking for a career where you'll be challenged to think from day one, we'd like to hear from you. **What you'll do**No two projects at Two Circles are quite the same. As an Analyst, you'll work with colleagues and clients to solve real commercial challenges, using data, technology and your own curiosity to understand fans and turn that understanding into action.
* Find the story in the data. Work with fan, ticketing, digital and commercial data to spot patterns, test hypotheses and uncover insights that can help some of the world's leading sports organisations grow their audiences and revenues.
* Turn insight into action. Go beyond producing analysis. You'll help work out what it means, what our clients should do next, and how we can turn an interesting finding into a clear commercial, marketing or sponsorship strategy.
* Build, test and improve. Help design and deliver initiatives ranging from fan research and event surveys to digital marketing campaigns, measuring what works and continually looking for ways to make it better.
* Communicate and influence. Turn complex analysis into clear, compelling recommendations, and learn how to present your thinking to colleagues, clients and senior stakeholders. You'll build relationships with people across different disciplines, organisations and markets.
* Stay curious. Keep asking questions about how sport, entertainment and fandom are changing. You'll explore new platforms, technologies, behaviours and commercial models, and think about what they could mean for our clients and their fans.
**Requirements**
If this sounds exciting but you've never done some of it before, you're in exactly the right place. We don't expect you to arrive knowing how to do the job – we'll teach you. We're much more interested in how you think, how you learn and what you'll bring to the team.
There is no single profile for a Two Circles Analyst, but the people who thrive here tend to have a few things in common:
* You're curious. You ask good questions, want to understand why things happen, and aren't satisfied with taking an answer at face value. You might be just as interested in why fans behave the way they do as you are in what they do.
* You like solving problems. You enjoy getting stuck into something complicated, breaking it down and working towards an answer. You're comfortable thinking independently, but you also know that the best answers often come from working with other people.
* You're comfortable with numbers. You don't need to be a data scientist or an Excel expert – we'll teach you the tools you need. But you should enjoy working with data, be comfortable in a spreadsheet, and be interested in using evidence to answer questions and make decisions.
* You learn quickly – and want to keep learning. You seek out feedback, take ownership of your development and are willing to try things you haven't done before.
* You're good with people. You listen, communicate clearly and adapt to the people around you. You'll care about being a great teammate and, over time, build the confidence and judgement to become a trusted partner to our clients.
* You care about getting things right. Whether you're analysing thousands of fan records or preparing something for a client, you notice the details, question things that don't look right and take pride in the quality of your work.
* You're interested in the business of sport and entertainment. You don't need to know every score, player or statistic. What matters more is a curiosity about the industry: how fans behave, how organisations grow, how brands connect with audiences, and how sport and entertainment are changing.
Above all, we're looking for people with potential. We can teach you the tools. We're looking for people who are curious, think critically, ask great questions, and bring the drive and energy to keep learning.
**Benefits**
*We offer a benefits package to suit you and your lifestyle! Out of a core monthly budget, you can choose your own comprehensive benefits package:*
* Renowned Team Days often throughout the year
* Summer Away Days
* 23 standard days of holiday (+ 1 Birthday, +2 for a ‘Big Life Event’ and +1 Admin Day), closure of office over Christmas (plus Bank Holidays)
* Discretionary Bonus based on company performance
* Performance Reviews every 6 months with discretionary salary increases
* Private healthcare (Vitality) and/or Health Care Plan (Medicash)
* Mobile phone contribution
* Sport Challenge contribution
* Gym membership contribution
* 2x annual kit drops
*Though these are the basics written down, we will principally be recruiting for energy, values and commitment – both to Two Circles and to your career. Even if you feel you don’t tick 100% of the boxes but feel you could bring value to the role, we’d still love to hear from you!* **What to Expect: Our Interview Process** **Stage 1 - Submit your application and complete our data quiz assessment**
**Stage 2 - Answer our application questions**
**Stage 3 - Speak with us in a screening interview**
**Stage 4 - Attend our assessment centre (or 'Try-outs Day'), which will take place in Winter 2027.**
**Please be aware, we encourage individuals to apply early, we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis, and may close the application process once we have received a sufficient number of candidates.** *Our recruitment process will be honest & thorough, and so will our roles. In return, we can offer honesty, integrity, and the chance to progress in the organisation as quickly as you develop within it.*

**Purpose** You’ll be joining our Atmosphere, Ice, & Climate (AIC) team to work on a new project Rain on Antarctic Sea Ice and Its Impacts (ROASII). This project will provide new understanding and quantification of anticipated increases in rainfall and its effect on Antarctic sea ice. Ongoing climate warming is expected to drive major changes in the Southern Ocean environment, including more frequent rainfall and air temperatures above freezing. Warmer and wetter conditions increase the likelihood of melt ponds forming on Antarctic sea ice. Melt ponds would accelerate Antarctic sea ice summer decay, impacting multiple oceanic, glaciological, and ecological systems in the Southern Hemisphere, enhancing polar amplification, and influencing global climate. Yet, there is a clear lack of understanding of, first, how rainfall will change in the future and, second, how it will impact sea ice.
You’ll help us to deliver the BAS contribution to this work, which will focus primarily on using models and observations to quantify the present-day occurrences of rainfall over Antarctic sea ice and enhance our understanding of the processes responsible for this, as well as develop realistic projections of rainfall over Antarctic sea ice for the future. Within the role, there will be opportunities to develop your teamwork skills as you collaborate with scientists from BAS and the Universities of Leeds and Reading, as well as international peers. Other scientists involved in the project will work on improving the representation of the effects of rain in a sea ice model and use it to evaluate the impact of rainfall on the formation of melt ponds and Antarctic sea ice, and future changes. You will be able to benefit from the many training and development opportunities that UKRI and BAS have to offer.
Current projects the team are working on include ExtAnt (Drivers and Impacts of Extreme Weather in Antarctica; https://extant.ac.uk), PICANTE (Processes, Impacts, and Changes of ANTarctic Extreme Weather; https://cpom.org.uk/picante/), PolarRES (Polar Regions in the Earth System; https://polarres.eu), SURFEIT (Surface Fluxes in Antarctica; https://surfeit.ac.uk), and Antarctic-CORDEX (COrdinated Regional Downscaling EXperiment; https://climate-cryosphere.org/antarctic-cordex/). ExtAnt, PICANTE, and SURFEIT are investigating Antarctic extreme events and their impacts and therefore have a lot of synergies with ROASII. PolarRES and Antarctic CORDEX focus on producing state-of-the-art regional climate model (RCM) simulations, which the ROASII project will use to quantify the present-day occurrences of rainfall over Antarctic sea ice.
**Duties** • Compare rain and snowfall characteristics over Antarctic sea ice from RCM datasets with observations, especially from cloud profiling radar products, and identify the best performing model dataset. • Use the best performing RCM dataset to quantify present-day occurrences of rainfall (and snowfall) over Antarctic sea ice. • Use the RCM and reanalysis datasets and innovative statistical techniques to determine the synoptic atmospheric processes and modes of atmospheric variability linked to rain on sea ice events. • Identify a subset of global climate models (GCMs) to derive improved projections of rainfall over Antarctic sea ice up to 2100. • Attend and contribute to project meetings and relevant international science conferences. • Lead the writing of scientific research papers.
**Skills, Qualifications, and Experience** **Essential** • PhD in atmospheric sciences, geosciences, or another relevant subject. • Experience analysing and visualising different climate datasets, including from model simulations, observations and reanalysis. • Good understanding of climate/meteorology. • Excellent numerical skills with a strong understanding of statistics. • Proficient in written and spoken English. • Ability to show initiative and to tackle problems independently. • Able to work as part of a team but also able to work independently. **Desirable** • Experience using cloud profiling radar products. • Good understanding of Antarctic climate/meteorology. • Track record of publishing in quality peer-reviewed literature. • Ability to work collaboratively with researchers at other institutions, particularly internationally.

The operations team cover a wide range of activities from managing Arctic and Antarctic Research stations, operating polar ships and aircraft. Our expertise is in polar fieldwork planning, aircraft and ship operations as well as developing engineering and technology solutions for science.

The role combines hands-on analytical leadership with strategic commercial influence. Working closely with the Chief Commercial Officer and Commercial Leadership Team, the role will use advanced modelling, rigorous analysis and strong commercial judgement to shape major commercial deals, investments and long-term strategy.
The postholder will have direct involvement in significant airline agreements, retail and food and beverage concessions, car parking and eCommerce strategy, property and surface-access opportunities, commercial performance analysis and major commercial transformation projects. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the technical capability to build and challenge complex models, the commercial acumen to identify what creates value, and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders. The postholder will remain personally involved in Edinburgh Airport’s most complex analysis, while developing the capability of the wider analytics team and ensuring consistently high analytical standards.

The first stage interview will be a short, Teams call to meet some of the team and introduce yourself. You can find out more about our interview process here.

Remain hands-on in complex analytical work, including personally building, interrogating and challenging models and undertaking detailed analysis where appropriate. Develop scalable analytical tools, models and approaches that improve the speed and quality of commercial decision-making. Develop appropriate KPIs, analytical frameworks and reporting to support effective commercial management. Identify trends, anomalies and changes in customer or commercial behaviour and translate these into actionable recommendations. Challenge existing reporting and analysis where it does not provide sufficient insight to support decision-making.
**Commercial strategy and decision support** Support the CCO and Commercial Leadership Team in developing and delivering Edinburgh Airport’s commercial strategy and Business Plan, providing rapid, evidence-based analytical support and ensuring recommendations combine rigorous quantitative analysis with commercial judgment. Translate complex data and market insight into clear strategic choices and commercially focused recommendations. Identify opportunities to create or protect revenue, profitability and long-term value.

We are Edinburgh Airport, where Scotland meets the world. The success of the airport comes down to our people, and you can help us deliver even more big days for our passengers and colleagues. Every audit we run asks whether an AI hiring system treats people fairly, and the answer has real consequences. Delivering each audit well matters as much as the methodology behind it.
As AI Audit Manager, you'll run audits of everything from resume screeners to AI interviewers. You'll own each one from scoping through onboarding and integration to presenting results and explaining what the standard requires, working closely with our data and engineering teams. When a result needs explaining, especially one a client didn't hope for, you'll be the person they turn to.

* Own first-line analysis when an audit is flagged, finding the cause in the data and bringing in the data team, who review and sign off every result before it goes to the client

* Join prospect calls to scope the audit, explain our methodology and answer questions about how it works
* Be every client's first point of contact, whether their question is about integration, results or methodology

* Shape our internal tools and audit pipeline as their main user, working with engineering and data on what gets built next
* Track key metrics like onboarding time and audit turnaround, and keep company leadership informed, escalating early when something goes wrong
* Share what you learn from clients across the company, from methodology and product to sales and marketing

* You own the audit cycle, and every client knows you're their first point of contact

* You've put runbooks, checklists and client intake forms in place for the most common work

# Sales Administrator
## Job Introduction
Love keeping things organised and making sure everything runs smoothly? We’re looking for someone to join our brilliant **Space Homes Sales Team** on a fixed term contract as a **Sales Administrator.** You’ll be the backbone of our operations - handling everything from customer records and data management to liaising with solicitors and estate agents. You’ll be supporting our customers through one of life’s biggest milestones, helping ensure their homebuying journey is smooth, professional and stress-free. All while working in a team that’s proud to make things happen.
**What we’re all about**
You can probably already tell that we’re not your typical housing provider! With around 20,000 homes (and more in the pipeline), we’re on track with our growth plan to build 8,000 new homes across Yorkshire.
You’ll be joining Yorkshire Housing’s very own sales brand, Space Homes - a creative and driven team with a strong commercial focus. They’re all about making the most of every opportunity, whether it’s selling new builds or existing homes for Market Sale or Shared Ownership. The income they generate goes straight back into Yorkshire Housing, helping us invest in our homes, services and communities.
For a lot of our customers, you’ll be their first impression of Yorkshire Housing and Space Homes, so you’ll need to feel confident taking phone calls and bring plenty of enthusiasm for sales!
**What will you be doing?**
As a Sales Administrator, you’ll be a friendly and reliable point of contact for customers throughout their Shared Ownership journey. You’ll help them understand every stage, from their first enquiry and application right through to reservation, completion and moving into their new home.
You’ll work closely with Sales Officers, mortgage brokers, financial advisers and teams across the business, providing accurate and proactive support to keep every sale moving smoothly. It’s a varied role where your great customer service, eye for detail and organisational skills will help you stay on top of records, paperwork, appointments, payments and internal systems.
You’ll also be:
* Responding to customer enquiries by phone, email and sometimes in person
* Maintaining accurate customer, property and sales records on the CRM and internal systems.
* Arranging viewings and valuations.
* Guiding customers through the Shared Ownership application and qualification process.
* Reviewing application documents to ensure they are in line with Homes England guidance and our Allocations Policy.
* Liaising with mortgage brokers and financial advisers to obtain affordability assessments for customers.
* Reviewing contracts and leases to ensure accuracy before they are signed by Governance
* Processing purchase orders, invoices, customer payments and account reconciliations.
* Sharing relevant information, such as handover packs, with customers and internal teams before and after completion
* Providing administrative support to help the Sales Team progress sales and meet its service standards and targets.
The Sales Team gets together in Leeds, West Yorkshire, around once a week, so you’ll need to be able to travel there and spend time with the team in person.
As this is a customer-facing role, you’ll also need to be available from 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday, helping us meet our customers’ needs while ensuring consistent cover across the team.
Sound like the role for you? You’ll find even more useful information in the Role Profile.
**What we’re looking for**
We’re after someone who’s super organised, great with people and confident juggling lots of moving parts. If you’ve got experience in property sales or a similar admin-heavy role, even better!
Here’s what will help you thrive in this role:
* You’re methodical and accurate, with a good eye for detail and a knack for keeping things tidy and on track.
* You’re flexible and happy to adapt when things change—because they often do!
* You’re confident working to targets and sticking to processes, but you also know how to get things done.
* You’re a clear communicator who’s comfortable dealing with colleagues, customers and external partners.
* You’ve got solid IT skills, especially in Microsoft Office (Excel is a must).
**What’s in it for you...**
* Salary: £25,896.81 per annum (35 hours/week)
* 26 days annual leave (rising to 31 annually) + Bank Holidays
* Fixed Term Contracts – 4/6 months
We offer a reward package to suit everyone. At YH, you can claim back for prescriptions, eye tests and more with our cash plan, make the most of a variety of retail discounts and take advantage of our pension scheme where we’ll match your contributions up to 9%, just to name a few.
Our people’s health and wellbeing is one of our top priorities, so you’ll have plenty of support when you need it. Our wellbeing package includes a library of free fitness classes, an instant My GP service and free counselling sessions with a trained professional.
Find out more about our employment perks here!
**Ready to apply?**
At YH, we’re actively building a working environment that’s inclusive as well as diverse, where everyone can contribute their best work and be themselves. We believe difference is what makes us stronger and recognise the importance of our teams reflecting communities we serve, so we welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds for this role.

Everyone has an idea of what a water company does. But for us, it's so much more than this.
We look after communities, protect the environment, and plan to look after Yorkshire's water, today, tomorrow 24/7, 365 days a year. We provide essential water and wastewater services to every corner of the Yorkshire region, and play a key role in the region's health, wellbeing, and prosperity.
New environmental legislation, unprecedented levels of investment and changing expectations from customers means that this is an exciting time to discover opportunities within the water industry. Water Service Delivery are a key part of how we plan to meet the changing expectations of customers and regulators.

* Locate external meter chambers/enter customer's premises, e.g. homes, factories, schools etc. on a cyclical basis to accurately record water meter readings.
* Ensure regular maintenance of meter reading rounds and location notes to agreed standards.
* Attend customer appointments to carry out basic investigations into high and low consumption and take appropriate action.
* Carry out ad hoc meter readings as required, e.g. checks and final reads.
* Identify and replace damaged meters where possible and in line with trained level of capability.
* Identify street furniture defects and undertake remedial action as appropriate.
* Ensure compliance with Health and Safety legislation and adherence to accident management procedures.
* Work as part of the team to deliver excellent performance by understanding how their individual performance links into achieving the team's wider objectives.
* Take personal responsibility for yourself and also others with respect to health and safety, risk management and control of work to ensure compliance with the YW Safety Policy.
* Demonstrate relentless drive, energy and determination to deliver sustainable outperformance for YW that rigorously achieves our vision to be clearly the best against demanding competitive industry benchmarks.
* Demonstrate financial awareness when making day to day business decisions.
**What skills & qualifications you will need:**
* This is an outdoors role so you must be comfortable working in all weathers and terrains.
* You will be carrying out a range of manual handling duties including heavy lifting of manhole covers.
* Experience of understanding where your role fits within a business plan and then developing ways to deliver the outputs.
* Full Driving Licence with less than 6 points.
* IT skills - Competent using MS Office applications and ability to quickly adapt to new systems.
* Experience of working independently.
* Experience of working in a Customer service environment.
**You will also benefit from having:**
* Previous meter reading experience.
* Understanding of household plumbing and water distribution.
* Experience of delivering against challenging business targets.
* Previous experience in a commercially orientated and / or regulated environment.
* Previous experience gained within the water or waste water sectors or within the broader utilities, process or manufacturing industry sectors.
Although we operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, it's important to us that we support flexible working patterns and job share options (when we can), to help you make the best of both your work and home life. We know that juggling childcare responsibilities or getting that ideal work/life balance isn't always easy!

All our roles are subject to a medical questionnaire, and further medicals when required.

## **About Zego 🚀**
At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. **We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance** 🤖
For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.
Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.
If you're ready to build the future of insurance, **we're hiring.**
**Purpose of the role**
As Head of Pricing - Insurance at Zego, you will lead the insurer’s technical view of the models that drive our pricing. That covers the actuarial risk models behind our net rates, the demand and market models, and any other predictive model used for pricing and underwriting decisions. The models are built by the MGA pricing teams using a mix of traditional techniques (GLM, GAM, GBM) as well as new AI driven approaches.
Your role is to make sure that we, as the insurer, can form an actuarial view on all of them, validate what sits underneath, and stand behind the rates it carries. On the actuarial risk models you will go further still, joining those projects from the start and owning the independent validation end to end.
You will do this as the senior technical voice in a small actuarial team, which brings real breadth alongside the depth. Alongside the models you will review pricing and underwriting proposals across both personal and commercial motor in close collaboration with our underwriting team, and you will bring the modelling view into portfolio management.
You will work directly with the MGA pricing teams, with underwriting and with our co-insurance partners, with access to senior leadership and to decision making from the first week.
**What you will be working on**
* Lead the insurer’s technical view across the full model landscape: the actuarial risk models, the demand models, the market and optimisation models. For each one the questions are the same: is the approach sound, can the output be trusted, and are we using it the way we intend to.
* Bring an actuarial view to all modelling approaches including AI driven models. Methods move quickly, you need to keep up.
* Go deeper on the actuarial risk models that set our net rates: join each project, independently validate the modelling decisions, the rating factor choices and the assumptions applied, and evidence the basis for each.
* Review, validate and challenge pricing and underwriting proposals across personal and commercial lines, working closely with our underwriting team: tactical pricing changes, full model updates, optimisation algorithms, new underwriting rules and renewal capping.
* Contribute to portfolio management and portfolio insight: what the KPIs are telling us, what is driving the movements, and what the modelling view says about where performance is heading.
* Support the insurer’s position with our co-insurance partners on the net rates, the quality of the models behind them and the validation we have carried out.
* Mentor and coach junior actuarial colleagues.
* Help build the processes, the governance and the tooling, including AI, that allow a small and senior team to work faster and more robustly.
**What you will need to be successful in the role**
* A qualified actuary, or an equivalent track record inside an actuarial pricing team, with at least ten years of hands-on modelling experience.
* Deep experience of classic actuarial risk modelling: GLMs built in Emblem, Akur8 or equivalent, with Python used in practice rather than in principle.
* Real exposure to the newer modelling approaches alongside the classic ones, such as GBMs and other machine learning methods, and the confidence to form an actuarial view on a method you have not built yourself.
* Experience with UK motor pricing. Experience with other lines of business is an advantage.
* Experience with newly launched portfolios, or portfolios with limited history.
* Experience with telematics products and their pricing.
* The judgement to say whether a model can be trusted, backed by having seen models work and seen them fail.
* Comfort in a small team with high influence and direct access to decision making, and a genuine interest in developing a less experienced colleague.
## **The Zego ways of working 🏡**
Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.
We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.
